data.description: 1.16, the release of the Nether Update, is a major update to Java Edition announced at MINECON Live 2019[2] and released on June 23, 2020.[3] It overhauls the Nether by adding four new biomes, four new mobs (the piglin, hoglin, zoglin, and strider), and a multitude of new blocks, as well...

<div style="width: 100%;"><div style="font-weight: bold; display: inline">This page covers a release version that has a major issue under certain conditions.</div> 
<div class="msgbox-text">The dedicated server for this version has <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Log4Shell" class="extiw" title="w:Log4Shell">a security vulnerability</a> in the <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Log4j" class="extiw" title="w:Log4j">Log4j</a> library that could be used to perform a remote code execution exploit. <div class="msgbox-text">See <a href="/w/Java_Edition_guides/Nether_Update" title="Java Edition guides/Nether Update">Java Edition guides/Nether Update</a>  for a guide to all of the new features introduced in Nether Update.</div>

<p><b>1.16</b>, the release of the <b><a href="/w/Nether_Update" title="Nether Update">Nether Update</a></b>, is a major update to <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a> announced at <a href="/w/MINECON_Live_2019" title="MINECON Live 2019">MINECON Live 2019</a><sup id="cite_ref-MINECON_article_2-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-MINECON_article-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and released on June 23, 2020.<sup id="cite_ref-nether-release_3-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-nether-release-3"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> It overhauls <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a> by adding four new biomes, four new mobs (the <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglin</a>, <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglin</a>, <a href="/w/Zoglin" title="Zoglin">zoglin</a>, and <a href="/w/Strider" title="Strider">strider</a>), and a multitude of new blocks, as well as the <a href="/w/Respawn_anchor" class="mw-redirect" title="Respawn anchor">respawn anchor</a> used to set the player's spawnpoint in the Nether. It also adds a new <a href="/w/Netherite" class="mw-disambig" title="Netherite">netherite</a> tier of equipment, obtained through <a href="/w/Ancient_debris" class="mw-redirect" title="Ancient debris">ancient debris</a> found rarely throughout the Nether.
</p><p>1.16 was reuploaded around 6 hours after release to attempt to fix an issue with the Realms menu which prevented clients from viewing and connecting to Realms (<span class="bug plainlinks" data-id="MC-191138"><a href="https://mojira.dev/MC-191138" class="extiw" title="mojira:MC-191138">MC-191138</a></span>). The changes were only to the client, and the server jar files are functionally identical.<sup id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> This hotfix was unsuccessful,<sup id="cite_ref-5" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-5"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>5<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and <a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16.1" title="Java Edition 1.16.1">1.16.1</a> was released the next day.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Blocks">Blocks</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=2&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Blocks" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=2" title="Edit section's source code: Blocks"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Ancient_Debris_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Ancient_Debris_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Ancient_Debris_JE1_BE1.png?571c1" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Ancient_Debris_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Ancient_Debris_JE1_BE1.png?571c1 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Ancient_debris" class="mw-redirect" title="Ancient debris">Ancient debris</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can be found throughout <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a> at any altitude, though it is much more common at lower altitudes (Y-levels 8–22).</li>
<li>Can be refined into a <a href="/w/Netherite_scrap" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite scrap">netherite scrap</a> by smelting in a <a href="/w/Furnace" title="Furnace">furnace</a> or <a href="/w/Blast_furnace" class="mw-redirect" title="Blast furnace">blast furnace</a>.</li>
<li>Same blast resistance as <a href="/w/Obsidian" title="Obsidian">obsidian</a>, but is movable with <a href="/w/Piston" title="Piston">pistons</a>.</li>
<li>Inventory item floats on <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a>.</li>
<li>Cannot burn in <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a> or <a href="/w/Fire" title="Fire">fire</a>.</li>
<li>A diamond or netherite <a href="/w/Pickaxe" title="Pickaxe">pickaxe</a> is required to mine it.</li>
<li>Always spawns covered by lava and/or blocks on all sides.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Basalt_(UD)_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Basalt_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Basalt_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.png?3adcd" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Basalt_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Basalt_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.png?3adcd 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Basalt" title="Basalt">Basalt</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Makes up <a href="/w/Basalt_pillar" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt pillar">basalt pillars</a>.</li>
<li>Generates in <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valleys</a> and <a href="/w/Basalt_deltas" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt deltas">basalt deltas</a>.</li>
<li>Can be placed directionally, similarly to <a href="/w/Log" title="Log">logs</a>.</li>
<li>Has a polished variant, obtained through the <a href="/w/Stonecutter" title="Stonecutter">stonecutter</a> or crafted from in a 2×2 grid, similar to other polished blocks.</li>
<li>Generates whenever <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a> touches <a href="/w/Blue_ice" class="mw-redirect" title="Blue ice">blue ice</a> while flowing over <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a>.</li></ul>
<figure class="mw-halign-right" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Blackstones.jpg" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Blackstones.jpg/295px-Blackstones.jpg?cabb7" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="295" height="156" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Blackstones.jpg/590px-Blackstones.jpg?cabb7 2x" data-file-width="1920" data-file-height="1017"></a><figcaption>All blackstone block variants.</figcaption></figure>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Blackstone_JE3_BE2.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Blackstone_JE3_BE2.png/32px-Blackstone_JE3_BE2.png?abdc1" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Blackstone_JE3_BE2.png/64px-Blackstone_JE3_BE2.png?abdc1 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Blackstone" title="Blackstone">Blackstone</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Generates in <a href="/w/Basalt_deltas" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt deltas">basalt deltas</a>.</li>
<li>Has a regular, polished, chiseled polished, polished brick and cracked polished brick variant.</li>
<li>Has regular, polished and polished brick slab, stair, and wall variants.</li>
<li>Has polished button and pressure plate variants.
<ul><li>Work like their stone counterparts.</li></ul></li>
<li>Can be used as an alternative in place of cobblestone for crafting <a href="/w/Furnace" title="Furnace">furnaces</a> and stone tools.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Block_of_Netherite_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Block_of_Netherite_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Block_of_Netherite_JE1_BE1.png?a781f" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Block_of_Netherite_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Block_of_Netherite_JE1_BE1.png?a781f 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Block_of_netherite" class="mw-redirect" title="Block of netherite">Block of netherite</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can be <a href="/w/Craft" class="mw-redirect" title="Craft">crafted</a> with 9 <a href="/w/Netherite_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite ingot">netherite ingots</a>.</li>
<li>Can be used as a <a href="/w/Beacon" title="Beacon">beacon</a> base.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Item" title="Item">Item</a> entity floats on <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a>.</li>
<li>Cannot <a href="/w/Burn" class="mw-redirect" title="Burn">burn</a> in <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a> or <a href="/w/Fire" title="Fire">fire</a>.</li>
<li>Same <a href="/w/Blast_resistance" class="mw-redirect" title="Blast resistance">blast resistance</a> as <a href="/w/Obsidian" title="Obsidian">obsidian</a>, but is movable with <a href="/w/Piston" title="Piston">pistons</a>.</li></ul>

<ul><li>New variant of <a href="/w/Nether_bricks" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether bricks">Nether bricks</a>.</li>
<li>Obtained by smelting Nether bricks in a furnace.</li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Crimson_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Crimson_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Crimson_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png?e3eed" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Crimson_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Crimson_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png?e3eed 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Warped_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Warped_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Warped_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png?95b25" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Warped_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Warped_Fungus_JE1_BE1.png?95b25 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Nether_Fungus" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether Fungus">Crimson and warped fungi</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Generate in <a href="/w/Crimson_Forest" title="Crimson Forest">crimson</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">warped forests</a>.</li>
<li>Can be placed on <a href="/w/Dirt" title="Dirt">dirt</a>, <a href="/w/Coarse_dirt" class="mw-redirect" title="Coarse dirt">coarse dirt</a>, <a href="/w/Farmland" title="Farmland">farmland</a>, <a href="/w/Podzol" title="Podzol">podzol</a>, <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a>, and <a href="/w/Grass_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Grass block">grass blocks</a>, and can also be placed in <a href="/w/Flower_pot" class="mw-redirect" title="Flower pot">flower pots</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">Bone meal</a> can be used on <a href="/w/Nether_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether fungi">Nether fungi</a> to grow it into the respective <a href="/w/Huge_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Huge fungi">huge fungi</a> when placed on the same type of <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a>.</li>
<li>Unlike <a href="/w/Mushroom" class="mw-disambig" title="Mushroom">mushrooms</a>, fungi do not spread over time.</li>
<li>Can be used in <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composters</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Crimson_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Crimson_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Crimson_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png?819ad" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Crimson_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Crimson_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png?819ad 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Warped_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Warped_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Warped_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png?50e47" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Warped_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Warped_Nylium_JE1_BE1.png?50e47 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">Crimson and warped nylium</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Resemble <a href="/w/Grass_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Grass block">grass blocks</a>.</li>
<li>Can be spread to <a href="/w/Netherrack" title="Netherrack">netherrack</a> by using <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">bone meal</a> on a netherrack block next to a nylium block.</li>
<li>Bone meal can be used on it to generate <a href="/w/Crimson_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson roots">crimson roots</a>, <a href="/w/Warped_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped roots">warped roots</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_sprouts" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether sprouts">Nether sprouts</a>, and <a href="/w/Nether_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether fungi">Nether fungi</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Crimson_Planks_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Crimson_Planks_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Crimson_Planks_JE1_BE1.png?04063" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Crimson_Planks_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Crimson_Planks_JE1_BE1.png?04063 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Warped_Planks_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Warped_Planks_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Warped_Planks_JE1_BE1.png?9ea67" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Warped_Planks_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Warped_Planks_JE1_BE1.png?9ea67 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Planks" title="Planks">Crimson and warped planks</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Wooden planks that do not burn.</li>
<li>Crafted from the respective stem.</li>
<li>Can be used to craft respective <a href="/w/Slab" title="Slab">slabs</a>, <a href="/w/Stairs" title="Stairs">stairs</a>, <a href="/w/Fence" title="Fence">fences</a>, <a href="/w/Fence_gate" class="mw-redirect" title="Fence gate">fence gates</a>, <a href="/w/Pressure_plate" class="mw-redirect" title="Pressure plate">pressure plates</a>, <a href="/w/Sign" title="Sign">signs</a>, <a href="/w/Button" title="Button">buttons</a>, <a href="/w/Door" title="Door">doors</a>, and <a href="/w/Trapdoor" title="Trapdoor">trapdoors</a>.</li>
<li>Cannot be used as <a href="/w/Furnace" title="Furnace">furnace</a> <a href="/w/Fuel" class="mw-redirect" title="Fuel">fuel</a>, since they do not burn.</li></ul>

</p>
<ul><li>Foliage that generates in both <a href="/w/Crimson_Forest" title="Crimson Forest">crimson</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">warped forest</a> biomes, as well as <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valleys</a>.</li>
<li>Can be placed into <a href="/w/Flower_pot" class="mw-redirect" title="Flower pot">flower pots</a>.</li>
<li>Can be used in <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composters</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Crimson_Stem_(UD)_JE1.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Crimson_Stem_%28UD%29_JE1.gif/32px-Crimson_Stem_%28UD%29_JE1.gif?166fa" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Crimson_Stem_%28UD%29_JE1.gif/64px-Crimson_Stem_%28UD%29_JE1.gif?166fa 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Warped_Stem_(UD)_JE1.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Warped_Stem_%28UD%29_JE1.gif/32px-Warped_Stem_%28UD%29_JE1.gif?4ceee" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Warped_Stem_%28UD%29_JE1.gif/64px-Warped_Stem_%28UD%29_JE1.gif?4ceee 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Log" title="Log">Crimson and warped stems</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Block" title="Block">Blocks</a> that comprise the <a href="/w/Trunk" class="mw-redirect" title="Trunk">trunks</a> of <a href="/w/Huge_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Huge fungi">huge fungi</a>.</li>
<li>Have animated textures.</li>
<li>Have a top texture similar to regular <a href="/w/Log" title="Log">log</a> blocks.</li>
<li>Can be placed directionally, similarly to <a href="/w/Log" title="Log">logs</a>.</li>
<li>Does not <a href="/w/Burn" class="mw-redirect" title="Burn">burn</a>.</li>
<li>Have respective <a href="/w/Stripped_Log" title="Stripped Log">stripped</a> variants.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Crying_Obsidian_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Crying_Obsidian_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Crying_Obsidian_JE1_BE1.png?9ebf7" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Crying_Obsidian_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Crying_Obsidian_JE1_BE1.png?9ebf7 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Crying_obsidian" class="mw-redirect" title="Crying obsidian">Crying obsidian</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><figure typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Crying_obsidian.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Crying_obsidian.png/294px-Crying_obsidian.png?1d5a4" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="294" height="165" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Crying_obsidian.png/588px-Crying_obsidian.png?1d5a4 2x" data-file-width="1920" data-file-height="1080"></a><figcaption>When obsidian cries, its tears stay on the ground for a while.</figcaption></figure> Used to craft <a href="/w/Respawn_anchor" class="mw-redirect" title="Respawn anchor">respawn anchors</a>.</li>
<li>Can be found in <a href="/w/Ruined_portal" class="mw-redirect" title="Ruined portal">ruined portals</a> and <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">bastion remnant</a> loot chests.</li>
<li>Can be obtained by <a href="/w/Bartering" title="Bartering">bartering</a> with <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a>.</li>
<li>Has a <a href="/w/Light" title="Light">light</a> level of 10.</li>
<li>Emits purple <a href="/w/Particles" title="Particles">particles</a>, resembling tears.</li>
<li>Has the same <a href="/w/Blast_resistance" class="mw-redirect" title="Blast resistance">blast resistance</a> as <a href="/w/Obsidian" title="Obsidian">obsidian</a>.</li>
<li>Programmer Art texture is the old texture from 2011.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Gilded_Blackstone_JE2_BE2.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Gilded_Blackstone_JE2_BE2.png/32px-Gilded_Blackstone_JE2_BE2.png?d9d7d" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Gilded_Blackstone_JE2_BE2.png/64px-Gilded_Blackstone_JE2_BE2.png?d9d7d 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Gilded_blackstone" class="mw-redirect" title="Gilded blackstone">Gilded blackstone</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>A variant of gold ore found in <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">bastion remnants</a>.</li>
<li>Variant of <a href="/w/Blackstone" title="Blackstone">blackstone</a>.</li>
<li>It has a chance to drop 2–5 golden nuggets when mined with a pickaxe.
<ul><li>If does not drop gold nuggets, then it drops itself.</li>
<li>As with the drop chance of <a href="/w/Flint" title="Flint">flint</a> from <a href="/w/Gravel" title="Gravel">gravel</a>, the <a href="/w/Fortune" title="Fortune">Fortune</a> enchantment does not increase the amount dropped, but increases the <i>chance</i> that gold nuggets drop.
<ul><li>Pickaxe without Fortune – 10% chance to drop 2–5 gold nuggets.</li>
<li>Pickaxe with Fortune I – 14.29% (<sup>1</sup>⁄<sub>7</sub>) chance to drop 2–5 gold nuggets.</li>
<li>Pickaxe with Fortune II – 25% chance to drop 2–5 gold nuggets.</li>
<li>Pickaxe with Fortune III – 100% chance to drop 2–5 gold nuggets.</li></ul></li>
<li>Silk Touch – always drops the block itself.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Crimson_Hyphae_(UD)_JE1_BE1.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Crimson_Hyphae_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.gif/32px-Crimson_Hyphae_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.gif?5d5f9" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Crimson_Hyphae_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.gif/64px-Crimson_Hyphae_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.gif?5d5f9 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Warped_Hyphae_(UD)_JE1_BE1.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Warped_Hyphae_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.gif/32px-Warped_Hyphae_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.gif?db0fd" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Warped_Hyphae_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.gif/64px-Warped_Hyphae_%28UD%29_JE1_BE1.gif?db0fd 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Hyphae" class="mw-redirect" title="Hyphae">Hyphae</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>A variant of stems with the bark on all 6 sides.</li>
<li>Also has a stripped variant.</li></ul>

<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Nether_Gold_Ore_JE2_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Nether_Gold_Ore_JE2_BE1.png/32px-Nether_Gold_Ore_JE2_BE1.png?c7842" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Nether_Gold_Ore_JE2_BE1.png/64px-Nether_Gold_Ore_JE2_BE1.png?c7842 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Nether_gold_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether gold ore">Nether gold ore</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>A variant of <a href="/w/Gold_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Gold ore">gold ore</a> found in <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a>.</li>
<li>Drops 2–6 <a href="/w/Gold_nugget" class="mw-redirect" title="Gold nugget">gold nuggets</a> when mined.
<ul><li>This is affected by <a href="/w/Fortune" title="Fortune">Fortune</a> the same way other ores are, for a maximum possible drop of 24 golden nuggets with <a href="/w/Fortune" title="Fortune">Fortune</a> III.</li>
<li>Nether gold ore, obtained with <a href="/w/Silk_Touch" title="Silk Touch">Silk Touch</a>, can still be smelted into a single <a href="/w/Gold_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Gold ingot">gold ingot</a>.</li></ul></li>
<li>Can be mined with any pickaxe.</li>
<li>Also drops <a href="/w/Experience_orb" class="mw-redirect" title="Experience orb">experience orbs</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Nether_Sprouts_JE2_BE2.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Nether_Sprouts_JE2_BE2.png/32px-Nether_Sprouts_JE2_BE2.png?849a9" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Nether_Sprouts_JE2_BE2.png/64px-Nether_Sprouts_JE2_BE2.png?849a9 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Nether_sprouts" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether sprouts">Nether sprouts</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Foliage that generates in <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">warped forests</a>.</li>
<li>Resembles <a href="/w/Grass" class="mw-disambig" title="Grass">grass</a> from the Overworld.</li>
<li>Requires <a href="/w/Shears" title="Shears">shears</a> to be obtained.</li>
<li>Can be used in <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composters</a>.</li></ul>

</p>
<ul><li>Crafted with 6 <a href="/w/Crying_obsidian" class="mw-redirect" title="Crying obsidian">crying obsidian</a> and 3 <a href="/w/Glowstone" title="Glowstone">glowstone</a>.</li>
<li>Can be used to set spawn points in <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a>, using glowstone as charges.</li>
<li>A maximum of 4 charges can be set at once, and one charge is depleted with each respawn.
<ul><li><a href="/w/Redstone_comparator" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone comparator">Redstone comparators</a> can track how much it is charged.</li></ul></li>
<li>Emits a slight amount of light, which gets stronger for each charge added.</li>
<li>Using it in <a href="/w/The_End" title="The End">the End</a> or the <a href="/w/Overworld" title="Overworld">Overworld</a> causes it to explode and set fire to surrounding blocks similar to <a href="/w/Bed" title="Bed">beds</a> in the Nether or the End.</li>
<li>Can be charged using a dispenser.</li>
<li>The <a href="/w/Nether_Portal_(block)" title="Nether Portal (block)">portal</a> animation on the top texture is inverted from the <a href="/w/Nether_Portal_(block)" title="Nether Portal (block)">Nether portal</a> texture.<sup id="cite_ref-6" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-6"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Has an advancement called <a href="/w/Not_Quite_%22Nine%22_Lives" class="mw-redirect" title="Not Quite "Nine" Lives">Not Quite "Nine" Lives</a>. To complete, a <a href="/w/Respawn_anchor" class="mw-redirect" title="Respawn anchor">respawn anchor</a> must be charged to its maximum (four).</li></ul>

<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Shroomlight_JE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Shroomlight_JE1.png/32px-Shroomlight_JE1.png?5c263" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Shroomlight_JE1.png/64px-Shroomlight_JE1.png?5c263 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Shroomlight" title="Shroomlight">Shroomlight</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Emits a light level of 15, similarly to <a href="/w/Glowstone" title="Glowstone">glowstone</a>.</li>
<li>Can be mined with any <a href="/w/Tool" title="Tool">tool</a>, but <a href="/w/Hoe" title="Hoe">hoes</a> are the most effective.</li>
<li>Generate as a part of <a href="/w/Huge_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Huge fungi">huge fungi</a>.</li>
<li>Can be used in <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composters</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Soul_Campfire_JE1_BE1.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Soul_Campfire_JE1_BE1.gif/32px-Soul_Campfire_JE1_BE1.gif?bf4a7" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Soul_Campfire_JE1_BE1.gif/64px-Soul_Campfire_JE1_BE1.gif?bf4a7 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Soul_campfire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul campfire">Soul campfire</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Soul variant of the normal campfire.</li>
<li>Has a blue flame instead of orange.</li>
<li>Gives off a light level of 10, with the normal campfire giving off 15.</li>
<li>Hay bales can increase smoke particle height.</li>
<li>Deals double damage compared to the normal <a href="/w/Campfire" title="Campfire">campfire</a>.</li>
<li>Crafted with soul sand or soul soil instead of coal.</li>
<li>Piglins are repelled by soul campfires.</li></ul>

<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Soul_Fire_JE1.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Soul_Fire_JE1.gif/32px-Soul_Fire_JE1.gif?b65b1" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="35" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Soul_Fire_JE1.gif/64px-Soul_Fire_JE1.gif?b65b1 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="328"></a></span> <a href="/w/Soul_fire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul fire">Soul fire</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Blue variant of <a href="/w/Fire" title="Fire">fire</a>.</li>
<li>Fire lit on <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a> or <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a> turns into soul fire regardless of dimension.
<ul><li>Burns forever, similarly to <a href="/w/Netherrack" title="Netherrack">netherrack</a> and <a href="/w/Magma_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Magma block">magma blocks</a>.</li></ul></li>
<li>Generates naturally in the <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valley</a> biome in <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a>.</li>
<li>Deals damage at a rate of 2<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="1 heart"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="❤️" src="/images/Heart_%28icon%29.png?faf83" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span></span> per second as opposed to the 1<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="0.5 hearts"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="💔" src="/images/Half_Heart_%28icon%29.png?cb16e" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span></span> per second of regular fire.</li>
<li>Does not extinguish when in the rain.<sup id="cite_ref-7" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-7"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>7<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Soul_Lantern.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Soul_Lantern.png/32px-Soul_Lantern.png?42020" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Soul_Lantern.png/64px-Soul_Lantern.png?42020 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Soul_lantern" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul lantern">Soul lantern</a></b>

<li>Has an animated texture, just like its Overworld counterpart.</li></ul>

</p>
<ul><li>Generates in the <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valley</a>, alongside conventional <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Fire" title="Fire">Fire</a> lit on soul soil is blue, and is called <a href="/w/Soul_fire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul fire">soul fire</a>.</li>
<li>The <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a> does not sink and is not slowed when walking in soul soil.</li>
<li>Considered a full <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">block</a>, unlike soul sand.</li>
<li>Can be used to summon the <a href="/w/Wither" title="Wither">wither</a>.</li>
<li>Works with the newly-added Soul Speed <a href="/w/Enchantment" title="Enchantment">enchantment</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Target_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Target_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Target_JE1_BE1.png?68c73" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Target_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Target_JE1_BE1.png?68c73 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Target" title="Target">Target</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Redstone" class="mw-disambig" title="Redstone">Redstone</a> component that can be activated by shooting <a href="/w/Projectile" title="Projectile">projectiles</a> into it.
<ul><li>Signal is stronger depending on how close the projectile is to the center of the block. The signal strength goes up to 15.</li></ul></li>
<li>Can be crafted using a <a href="/w/Hay_bale" class="mw-redirect" title="Hay bale">hay bale</a> and 4 <a href="/w/Redstone_dust" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone dust">redstone dust</a>.</li>
<li>Can be mined with any <a href="/w/Tool" title="Tool">tool</a>, but <a href="/w/Hoe" title="Hoe">hoes</a> are the most effective.</li>
<li>Does not need a <a href="/w/Redstone_comparator" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone comparator">redstone comparator</a> to send a signal strength.</li></ul>

</p>
<ul><li>Generates in the <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">warped forest</a>.</li>
<li>Is placed on top of a block and grows upward, like kelp.</li>
<li>Can be climbed, like normal <a href="/w/Vines" title="Vines">vines</a>.</li>
<li>Growth can be accelerated with <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">bone meal</a>.</li>
<li>Can be used in <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composters</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Warped_Wart_Block_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Warped_Wart_Block_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Warped_Wart_Block_JE1_BE1.png?aff14" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Warped_Wart_Block_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Warped_Wart_Block_JE1_BE1.png?aff14 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> <a href="/w/Warped_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped wart block">Warped wart block</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>A variation of the <a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart block</a>, but cannot be crafted.</li>
<li>Generates as a part of huge warped fungi. Sometimes generates in the ground replacing the <a href="/w/Warped_nylium" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped nylium">warped nylium</a> in the warped forest biome.</li>
<li>Can be used in <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composters</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Weeping_Vines_JE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Weeping_Vines_JE1.png/32px-Weeping_Vines_JE1.png?369ca" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Weeping_Vines_JE1.png/64px-Weeping_Vines_JE1.png?369ca 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Weeping_Vines_Plant_JE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Weeping_Vines_Plant_JE1.png/32px-Weeping_Vines_Plant_JE1.png?8142b" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Weeping_Vines_Plant_JE1.png/64px-Weeping_Vines_Plant_JE1.png?8142b 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Weeping_vines" class="mw-redirect" title="Weeping vines">Weeping vines</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Generates in the <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forest</a>.</li>
<li>Is placed on the bottom of a block and grows downward.</li>
<li>Can be climbed, like other <a href="/w/Vines" title="Vines">vines</a>.</li>
<li>Growth can be accelerated with <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">bone meal</a>.</li>
<li>Can be used in <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composters</a>.</li></ul>
<figure typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Nether_plants.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Nether_plants.png/384px-Nether_plants.png?24e9c" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="384" height="216" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Nether_plants.png/768px-Nether_plants.png?24e9c 2x" data-file-width="1920" data-file-height="1080"></a><figcaption>The 2 variations of the new nether-themed colored blocks, crimson (right) and warped (left), along with a soul lantern.</figcaption></figure>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Items">Items</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=3&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Items" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section's source code: Items"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Lodestone_Compass_JE2_BE2.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Lodestone_Compass_JE2_BE2.gif/32px-Lodestone_Compass_JE2_BE2.gif?bf28b" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Lodestone_Compass_JE2_BE2.gif/64px-Lodestone_Compass_JE2_BE2.gif?bf28b 2x" data-file-width="160" data-file-height="160"></a></span> <a href="/w/Lodestone_compass" class="mw-redirect" title="Lodestone compass">Lodestone compass</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Created by using a <a href="/w/Lodestone" title="Lodestone">lodestone</a> with a <a href="/w/Compass" title="Compass">compass</a>.
<ul><li>Points toward that lodestone.
<ul><li>Keeps them stacked.</li></ul></li></ul></li>
<li>Entering another dimension other than the one containing the assigned lodestone causes the compass to spin uncontrollably, similar to regular compasses in the Nether or the End.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Music_Disc_Pigstep_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Music_Disc_Pigstep_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Music_Disc_Pigstep_JE1_BE1.png?b760c" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Music_Disc_Pigstep_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Music_Disc_Pigstep_JE1_BE1.png?b760c 2x" data-file-width="160" data-file-height="160"></a></span> <a href="/w/Music_disc" class="mw-redirect" title="Music disc">Music discs</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added the "<a href="/w/Music_Disc_Pigstep" title="Music Disc Pigstep">Pigstep</a>" music disc, composed by <a href="/w/Lena_Raine" title="Lena Raine">Lena Raine</a>.
<ul><li>Can be found only in <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">bastion remnants</a>.</li>
<li>Has a red disc color instead of black.</li>
<li>When played in a <a href="/w/Jukebox" title="Jukebox">jukebox</a>, a <a href="/w/Redstone_comparator" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone comparator">redstone comparator</a> output produces a signal strength of 13.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Netherite_Armor_JE2.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Netherite_Armor_JE2.png/32px-Netherite_Armor_JE2.png?0059a" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="60" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Netherite_Armor_JE2.png/64px-Netherite_Armor_JE2.png?0059a 2x" data-file-width="511" data-file-height="959"></a></span> <a href="/w/Netherite_armor" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite armor">Netherite armor</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Upgraded using a <a href="/w/Smithing_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Smithing table">smithing table</a> with a netherite ingot and the respective diamond item.</li>
<li>Does not burn in lava or fire, as a dropped item <i>or</i> when worn (its durability does not decrease when the player takes damage from lava) (<a href="/w/Player" title="Player">players</a> equipping netherite armor, however, can still take burning damage).</li>
<li>Floats in <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a>.</li>
<li>Tougher than diamond <a href="/w/Armor" title="Armor">armor</a>.</li>
<li>Has higher durability and enchantability than diamond, but not higher enchantability than gold.</li></ul>

<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Netherite_Ingot_JE1_BE2.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Netherite_Ingot_JE1_BE2.png/32px-Netherite_Ingot_JE1_BE2.png?79364" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Netherite_Ingot_JE1_BE2.png/64px-Netherite_Ingot_JE1_BE2.png?79364 2x" data-file-width="160" data-file-height="160"></a></span> <a href="/w/Netherite_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite ingot">Netherite ingot</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Created with 4 <a href="/w/Gold_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Gold ingot">gold ingots</a> and 4 <a href="/w/Netherite_scrap" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite scrap">netherite scraps</a>.</li>
<li>Can be used to upgrade diamond <a href="/w/Tool" title="Tool">tools</a> and <a href="/w/Armor" title="Armor">armor</a> in a <a href="/w/Smithing_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Smithing table">smithing table</a>.</li>
<li>Floats in lava.</li>
<li>Cannot burn in lava or fire.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Netherite_Scrap_JE2_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Netherite_Scrap_JE2_BE1.png/32px-Netherite_Scrap_JE2_BE1.png?ef2a4" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Netherite_Scrap_JE2_BE1.png/64px-Netherite_Scrap_JE2_BE1.png?ef2a4 2x" data-file-width="160" data-file-height="160"></a></span> <a href="/w/Netherite_scrap" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite scrap">Netherite scrap</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Created by smelting <a href="/w/Ancient_debris" class="mw-redirect" title="Ancient debris">ancient debris</a> in a <a href="/w/Furnace" title="Furnace">furnace</a> or <a href="/w/Blast_furnace" class="mw-redirect" title="Blast furnace">blast furnace</a>.</li>
<li>Used to create <a href="/w/Netherite_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite ingot">netherite ingots</a>.</li>
<li>Floats in lava.</li>
<li>Cannot burn in lava or fire.</li></ul>
<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Snout_banner_pattern.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Snout_banner_pattern.png/16px-Snout_banner_pattern.png?048e9" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="40" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Snout_banner_pattern.png/32px-Snout_banner_pattern.png?048e9 2x" data-file-width="341" data-file-height="849"></a></span> <a href="/w/Snout_banner_pattern" class="mw-redirect" title="Snout banner pattern">Snout banner pattern</a></b>

<li>Used in the <a href="/w/Loom" title="Loom">loom</a> to apply the Snout pattern to the banner.</li>
<li>Can be found in <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">bastion remnants</a>.</li></ul>

<li>Can be used to control <a href="/w/Strider" title="Strider">striders</a> in the same way as a <a href="/w/Carrot_on_a_stick" class="mw-redirect" title="Carrot on a stick">carrot on a stick</a> controls <a href="/w/Pig" title="Pig">pigs</a>.

<li>Has 100 durability as opposed to the <a href="/w/Carrot_on_a_stick" class="mw-redirect" title="Carrot on a stick">carrot on a stick</a>'s durability of 25.</li>
<li>Mending and Unbreaking can be applied using an anvil.</li></ul>

<p><b><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Hoglin_JE3.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Hoglin_JE3.png/32px-Hoglin_JE3.png?65eaa" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Hoglin_JE3.png/64px-Hoglin_JE3.png?65eaa 2x" data-file-width="1120" data-file-height="875"></a></span> <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">Hoglins</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Have 40<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="1 heart"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="❤️" src="/images/Heart_%28icon%29.png?faf83" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span> × 20</span> health.</li>
<li>Spawn in <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forests</a>.</li>
<li>Are a <a href="/w/Hostile_mob" class="mw-redirect" title="Hostile mob">hostile mob</a>.</li>
<li>Drop <a href="/w/Raw_porkchop" class="mw-redirect" title="Raw porkchop">raw porkchop</a> and <a href="/w/Leather" title="Leather">leather</a>.</li>
<li>Have an adult and baby variant.</li>
<li>Can be <a href="/w/Bred" class="mw-redirect" title="Bred">bred</a> with <a href="/w/Crimson_fungi" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson fungi">crimson fungi</a>.</li>
<li>Are hunted by adult <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a>.
<ul><li>Baby hoglins are not hunted and baby piglins do not hunt hoglins.</li></ul></li>
<li>Avoid placed <a href="/w/Warped_fungi" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped fungi">warped fungi</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_portal" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether portal">Nether portals</a>, and <a href="/w/Respawn_anchor" class="mw-redirect" title="Respawn anchor">respawn anchors</a>.</li>
<li>Convert into <a href="/w/Zoglin" title="Zoglin">zoglins</a> when in the Overworld or the End.
<ul><li>Have an <code>IsImmuneToZombification</code> data value that prevents them from zombifying in the <a href="/w/Overworld" title="Overworld">Overworld</a>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Piglin_JE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Piglin_JE1.png/32px-Piglin_JE1.png?a498e" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="49" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Piglin_JE1.png/64px-Piglin_JE1.png?a498e 2x" data-file-width="520" data-file-height="800"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Piglin_with_Crossbow_JE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Piglin_with_Crossbow_JE1.png/32px-Piglin_with_Crossbow_JE1.png?8aa13" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="49" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Piglin_with_Crossbow_JE1.png/64px-Piglin_with_Crossbow_JE1.png?8aa13 2x" data-file-width="520" data-file-height="800"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">Piglins</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Have 16<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="1 heart"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="❤️" src="/images/Heart_%28icon%29.png?faf83" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span> × 8</span> health.</li>
<li>Spawn in <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forests</a> and <a href="/w/Nether_wastes" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wastes">Nether wastes</a> biomes.</li>
<li>Randomly spawns with golden <a href="/w/Sword" title="Sword">sword</a> or <a href="/w/Crossbow" title="Crossbow">crossbow</a>.</li>
<li>Adults are <a href="/w/Hostile_mob" class="mw-redirect" title="Hostile mob">hostile</a>; babies are <a href="/w/Passive" class="mw-redirect" title="Passive">passive</a>.
<ul><li>Do not attack <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">players</a> wearing at least one piece of golden <a href="/w/Armor" title="Armor">armor</a>.</li>
<li>Adult <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a> turn aggressive when a player is mining "gold related" blocks (such as <a href="/w/Blocks_of_gold" class="mw-redirect" title="Blocks of gold">blocks of gold</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_gold_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether gold ore">Nether gold ore</a>, <a href="/w/Gilded_blackstone" class="mw-redirect" title="Gilded blackstone">gilded blackstone</a>, etc.) or opening/breaking <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chests</a>, even if they are wearing gold armor.</li></ul></li>
<li>The <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a> can <a href="/w/Barter" class="mw-redirect" title="Barter">barter</a> with them by interacting with them while holding gold ingots or dropping them on the ground, which makes them drop at least one item or block in return.</li>
<li>Occasionally attack adult <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglins</a>.</li>
<li>Up to 3 baby <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a> can ride on the back of baby hoglins.</li>
<li>Adults attack <a href="/w/Wither_skeleton" class="mw-redirect" title="Wither skeleton">wither skeletons</a> on sight.</li>
<li>Avoids <a href="/w/Soul_fire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul fire">soul fire</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_torch" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul torch">soul torches</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_lantern" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul lantern">soul lanterns</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_campfire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul campfire">soul campfires</a>, <a href="/w/Zombified_piglin" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombified piglin">zombified piglins</a>, and <a href="/w/Zoglin" title="Zoglin">zoglins</a>.</li>
<li>Can spawn with golden <a href="/w/Armor" title="Armor">armor</a>.</li>
<li>Convert to a <a href="/w/Zombified_piglin" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombified piglin">zombified piglin</a> when in the <a href="/w/Overworld" title="Overworld">Overworld</a> or <a href="/w/The_End" title="The End">the End</a>.
<ul><li>Have an <code>IsImmuneToZombification</code> data value that prevents them from zombifying in the <a href="/w/Overworld" title="Overworld">Overworld</a>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Strider_JE2_BE2.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Strider_JE2_BE2.gif/32px-Strider_JE2_BE2.gif?f8244" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="36" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Strider_JE2_BE2.gif/64px-Strider_JE2_BE2.gif?f8244 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="342"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Saddled_Strider_JE3.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Saddled_Strider_JE3.gif/32px-Saddled_Strider_JE3.gif?7e7f4" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="36" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Saddled_Strider_JE3.gif/64px-Saddled_Strider_JE3.gif?7e7f4 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="342"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Strider_Cold_JE3.gif" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Strider_Cold_JE3.gif/32px-Strider_Cold_JE3.gif?b32fa" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="36" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Strider_Cold_JE3.gif/64px-Strider_Cold_JE3.gif?b32fa 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="342"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Strider" title="Strider">Striders</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Have 20<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="1 heart"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="❤️" src="/images/Heart_%28icon%29.png?faf83" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span> × 10</span> health.</li>
<li>A <a href="/w/Passive_mob" class="mw-redirect" title="Passive mob">passive mob</a> that spawns in <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a> on lava oceans.</li>
<li>Drops <a href="/w/String" title="String">strings</a>.</li>
<li>Can be saddled and controlled with a <a href="/w/Warped_fungus_on_a_stick" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped fungus on a stick">warped fungus on a stick</a>.</li>
<li>Moves in and out of lava.
<ul><li>Shivers and turns blueish-purple when out of lava.</li>
<li>Moves significantly slower out of lava.</li></ul></li>
<li>Is damaged by <a href="/w/Water" title="Water">water</a> and <a href="/w/Rain" title="Rain">rain</a>.</li>
<li>Has a baby variant.</li>
<li>Can be bred using <a href="/w/Warped_fungi" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped fungi">warped fungi</a>.</li>
<li>Adults can spawn with baby striders riding them.</li>
<li>Can spawn with <a href="/w/Zombified_piglin" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombified piglin">zombified piglins</a> riding them.
<ul><li>If they spawn with a zombified piglin, they also have a saddle equipped.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Zoglin_JE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Zoglin_JE1.png/32px-Zoglin_JE1.png?6fd4b" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Zoglin_JE1.png/64px-Zoglin_JE1.png?6fd4b 2x" data-file-width="1120" data-file-height="875"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Baby_Zoglin_JE3_BE4.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Baby_Zoglin_JE3_BE4.png/32px-Baby_Zoglin_JE3_BE4.png?e3d52" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="28" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Baby_Zoglin_JE3_BE4.png/64px-Baby_Zoglin_JE3_BE4.png?e3d52 2x" data-file-width="951" data-file-height="825"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Zoglin" title="Zoglin">Zoglins</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Have 40<span class="hidden-alt-text">HP</span><span class="nowrap mc-hearts"><span class="iconbar pixel-image nowrap" style="--icon-offset:-1px;" title="1 heart"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="❤️" src="/images/Heart_%28icon%29.png?faf83" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="9" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="9" data-file-height="9"></span></span></span> × 20</span> health.</li>
<li>A zombified variant of the hoglin.</li>
<li>Created when a hoglin is brought into the Overworld.</li>
<li>Unlike hoglins, they cannot be bred or fed, and they do not flee from <a href="/w/Warped_fungi" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped fungi">warped fungi</a>.</li>
<li>Attack most mobs on sight, except for <a href="/w/Creeper" title="Creeper">creepers</a>, <a href="/w/Ghast" title="Ghast">ghasts</a>, and other zoglins.</li>
<li>Drops <a href="/w/Rotten_flesh" class="mw-redirect" title="Rotten flesh">rotten flesh</a>.</li>
<li>Takes more damage with Smite, as it is considered an undead mob.</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="World_generation">World generation</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=5&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: World generation" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section's source code: World generation"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b><a href="/w/Biome" title="Biome">Biomes</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:BiomeSprite_basalt-deltas.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/BiomeSprite_basalt-deltas.png?cebf5" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> <a href="/w/Basalt_deltas" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt deltas">Basalt deltas</a>
<ul><li>A volcanic biome in the Nether. Filled with pillars of <a href="/w/Basalt" title="Basalt">basalt</a> and large areas of <a href="/w/Blackstone" title="Blackstone">blackstone</a>. The air is filled with a light gray ash-like particle.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Ghast" title="Ghast">Ghasts</a>, <a href="/w/Magma_cube" class="mw-redirect" title="Magma cube">magma cubes</a>, and <a href="/w/Strider" title="Strider">striders</a> can spawn here.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:BiomeSprite_crimson-forest.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/BiomeSprite_crimson-forest.png?30bb0" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">Crimson forests</a>
<ul><li>A dense forest with <a href="/w/Huge_crimson_fungi" class="mw-redirect" title="Huge crimson fungi">huge crimson fungi</a>. <a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart blocks</a> and <a href="/w/Nether_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether fungi">Nether fungi</a> are found in patches on the ground and <a href="/w/Weeping_vines" class="mw-redirect" title="Weeping vines">weeping vines</a> are found under the trees and Nether wart “stalactites”. Fog effects are similar to the <a href="/w/Nether_wastes" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wastes">Nether wastes</a> biome.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Zombified_piglin" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombified piglin">Zombified piglins</a>, <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a>, and <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglins</a> can spawn here.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:BiomeSprite_soul-sand-valley.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/BiomeSprite_soul-sand-valley.png?37c28" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">Soul sand valleys</a>
<ul><li>A vast grotto composed of uncovered <a href="/w/Nether_fossil" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether fossil">Nether fossils</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a>, large pillars made of <a href="/w/Basalt" title="Basalt">basalt</a>, blue fog, and <a href="/w/Soul_fire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul fire">soul fire</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Skeleton" title="Skeleton">Skeletons</a>, <a href="/w/Ghast" title="Ghast">ghasts</a>, and <a href="/w/Endermen" class="mw-redirect" title="Endermen">endermen</a> can spawn here.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:BiomeSprite_warped-forest.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/BiomeSprite_warped-forest.png?2bf52" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="16" height="16" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">Warped forests</a>
<ul><li>A blue color variation of the <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forest</a>, but with somewhat different vegetation and blue particles and fog effects.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Endermen" class="mw-redirect" title="Endermen">Endermen</a> and <a href="/w/Strider" title="Strider">striders</a> can spawn here.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Structure" title="Structure">Structures</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Basalt_Pillar.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Basalt_Pillar.png/10px-Basalt_Pillar.png?390ff" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="10" height="42" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Basalt_Pillar.png/20px-Basalt_Pillar.png?390ff 2x" data-file-width="488" data-file-height="2027"></a></span> <a href="/w/Basalt_pillar" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt pillar">Basalt pillars</a>
<ul><li>Floor to ceiling pillars of <a href="/w/Basalt" title="Basalt">basalt</a> that generate in <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valleys</a>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Bastion_Remnant_1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Bastion_Remnant_1.png/28px-Bastion_Remnant_1.png?f2896" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="28" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Bastion_Remnant_1.png/56px-Bastion_Remnant_1.png?f2896 2x" data-file-width="1790" data-file-height="2055"></a></span></span><span><span class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Bastion_Remnant_2.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Bastion_Remnant_2.png/25px-Bastion_Remnant_2.png?fbeb6" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="25" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Bastion_Remnant_2.png/50px-Bastion_Remnant_2.png?fbeb6 2x" data-file-width="1516" data-file-height="1938"></a></span></span><span><span class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Bastion_Remnant_3.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Bastion_Remnant_3.png/24px-Bastion_Remnant_3.png?e2d01" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Bastion_Remnant_3.png/48px-Bastion_Remnant_3.png?e2d01 2x" data-file-width="1520" data-file-height="2001"></a></span></span><span><span class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Bastion_Remnant_4.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Bastion_Remnant_4.png/32px-Bastion_Remnant_4.png?f1c39" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Bastion_Remnant_4.png/63px-Bastion_Remnant_4.png?f1c39 2x" data-file-width="1985" data-file-height="2013"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">Bastion remnants</a>
<ul><li>Generate in all <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">Nether</a> biomes, except <a href="/w/Basalt_deltas" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt deltas">basalt deltas</a>.</li>
<li>Four types of structures generate; Bridge, Hoglin Stable, Housing Units, and Treasure Room.</li>
<li>Are the only source of the "<a href="/w/Pigstep" class="mw-redirect" title="Pigstep">Pigstep</a>" music disc.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">Piglins</a> and <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglins</a> spawn here.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Monster_spawner" class="mw-redirect" title="Monster spawner">Monster spawners</a> that spawn <a href="/w/Magma_cube" class="mw-redirect" title="Magma cube">magma cubes</a> can be found in bastion remnants.</li>
<li>Piglins have more gold armor parts if spawn here.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Huge_Crimson_fungi.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Huge_Crimson_fungi.png/32px-Huge_Crimson_fungi.png?fa3d5" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="44" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Huge_Crimson_fungi.png/64px-Huge_Crimson_fungi.png?fa3d5 2x" data-file-width="449" data-file-height="621"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Huge_Warped_fungi.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Huge_Warped_fungi.png/32px-Huge_Warped_fungi.png?1c7f1" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="42" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Huge_Warped_fungi.png/64px-Huge_Warped_fungi.png?1c7f1 2x" data-file-width="477" data-file-height="621"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Huge_crimson_fungi" class="mw-redirect" title="Huge crimson fungi">Huge crimson fungi</a> and <a href="/w/Huge_warped_fungi" class="mw-redirect" title="Huge warped fungi">huge warped fungi</a>
<ul><li>New structures resembling trees found in crimson and warped forests, respectively. They resemble <a href="/w/Tree" title="Tree">trees</a> in the Overworld.</li>
<li>Made of crimson and warped stem blocks as well as <a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart blocks</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped wart block">warped wart blocks</a>. Resembles <a href="/w/Leaves" title="Leaves">leaves</a> in Overworld.</li>
<li>Can be grown from their respective <a href="/w/Nether_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether fungi">Nether fungi</a>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Nether_fossil_1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Nether_fossil_1.png/32px-Nether_fossil_1.png?7295c" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="28" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Nether_fossil_1.png/64px-Nether_fossil_1.png?7295c 2x" data-file-width="1178" data-file-height="1033"></a></span> <a href="/w/Nether_fossil" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether fossil">Nether fossils</a>
<ul><li>New fossil structures have been added for the <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valley</a>.
<ul><li>These fossils are different from the Overworld fossils and generate random pieces of <a href="/w/Basalt" title="Basalt">basalt</a> instead of <a href="/w/Coal_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Coal ore">coal ore</a>.</li></ul></li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li><span class="animated"><span class="animated-active"><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Overworld_portal_1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Overworld_portal_1.png/32px-Overworld_portal_1.png?f3f26" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="39" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Overworld_portal_1.png/64px-Overworld_portal_1.png?f3f26 2x" data-file-width="557" data-file-height="687"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Overworld_Giant_portal_1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Overworld_Giant_portal_1.png/32px-Overworld_Giant_portal_1.png?3c80f" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="39" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Overworld_Giant_portal_1.png/64px-Overworld_Giant_portal_1.png?3c80f 2x" data-file-width="1168" data-file-height="1439"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Nether_portal_1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Nether_portal_1.png/32px-Nether_portal_1.png?c4674" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="39" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Nether_portal_1.png/64px-Nether_portal_1.png?c4674 2x" data-file-width="557" data-file-height="687"></a></span></span><span><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Nether_Giant_portal_1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Nether_Giant_portal_1.png/32px-Nether_Giant_portal_1.png?e8230" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="39" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Nether_Giant_portal_1.png/64px-Nether_Giant_portal_1.png?e8230 2x" data-file-width="1168" data-file-height="1439"></a></span></span></span> <a href="/w/Ruined_portal" class="mw-redirect" title="Ruined portal">Ruined portals</a>
<ul><li>Shattered remains of <a href="/w/Nether_portal" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether portal">Nether portals</a>.</li>
<li>Generate in both <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a> and the <a href="/w/Overworld" title="Overworld">Overworld</a>.</li>
<li>Can be buried underground or underwater.</li>
<li>A loot chest can be found beside the portal.</li></ul></li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Command_format">Command format</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=6&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Command format" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section's source code: Command format"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/attribute" title="Commands/attribute">attribute</a></span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Used to get, set, or modify <a href="/w/Attribute" title="Attribute">attributes</a>.</li>
<li>Possible syntax: Parameters:
<ul><li><code>attribute <target> <attribute> get [<scale>]</code> – get total value of attribute</li>
<li><code>attribute <target> <attribute> base set <value></code> – sets base value</li>
<li><code>attribute <target> <attribute> base get [<scale>]</code> – get base value</li>
<li><code>attribute <target> <attribute> modifier add <uuid> <name> <value> add</code> <code>multiply</code> <code>multiply_base</code> – adds modifier (fails if modifier is already present)</li>
<li><code>attribute <target> <attribute> modifier remove <uuid></code> – removes modifier</li>
<li><code>attribute <target> <attribute> modifier value get <uuid> [<scale>]</code> – get value of modifier</li>
<li><code>target</code> – single entity (note: only players, armor stands and mobs have attributes)</li>
<li><code>attribute</code> – name of attribute (like <code>minecraft:generic.max_health</code>)</li>
<li><code>name</code> – string (in optional quotes) describing human-readable name of modifier</li>
<li><code>value</code> – floating point value (note: Certain attributes have limits on final value, so the change might not be noticeable)</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/locatebiome" title="Commands/locatebiome">locatebiome</a></span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Used to locate specific <a href="/w/Biome" title="Biome">biomes</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/gamerule" title="Commands/gamerule">gamerule</a> forgiveDeadPlayers</span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Makes angered neutral mobs stop being angry when the targeted player dies nearby.</li>
<li>Enabled by default.</li></ul>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/gamerule" title="Commands/gamerule">gamerule</a> universalAnger</span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Makes angered neutral mobs attack any nearby player, not just the player that angered them. Works best if <code>forgiveDeadPlayers</code> is disabled.</li>
<li>Disabled by default.</li></ul>

<ul><li>All of these advancements are located in the "Nether" tab, except "Bullseye", which is located in the "Adventure" tab.
<ul><li>"Bullseye", "Cover Me in Debris", and "Hot Tourist Destinations" are challenge advancements, while the others are "normal" advancements.</li></ul></li></ul>
<ul><li>Added a <code>smokey</code> property to the <code>location</code> trigger which checks if the location is closely above a campfire.</li>
<li>Added <code>thrown_item_picked_up_by_entity</code> advancement trigger.
<ul><li><code>item</code> matches the thrown item which was picked up.</li>
<li><code>entity</code> matches the entity which picked up the item.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added <code>player_generates_container_loot</code> advancement trigger.
<ul><li><code>loot_table</code> matches the resource location of the generated loot table.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added <code>item_used_on_block</code> advancement trigger.
<ul><li><code>location</code> matches the location at the center of the block the item was used on.</li>
<li><code>item</code> matches the item used on the block.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added <code>player_interacted_with_entity</code> advancement trigger.
<ul><li><code>item</code> matches the item which was in the player's hand during interaction.</li>
<li><code>entity</code> matches the entity which was interacted with.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Bartering" title="Bartering">Bartering</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added new bartering mechanic, through which the player can trade items with piglins.</li>
<li>Bartering is done by interacting with piglins when holding gold ingots or dropping them on the ground, which makes the piglin drop at least one item or block in return, with different blocks and items having varying rarities.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Death_messages" title="Death messages">Death messages</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a new death message for being killed by another player's firework using a crossbow.
<ul><li>"[player] went off with a bang due to a firework fired from [item] by [player/mob]"</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Enchanting" class="mw-redirect" title="Enchanting">Enchanting</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added the <a href="/w/Soul_Speed" title="Soul Speed">Soul Speed</a> enchantment.
<ul><li>A new treasure enchantment obtainable only via <a href="/w/Bartering" title="Bartering">bartering</a> with <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a> or in <a href="/w/Chest_loot" class="mw-redirect" title="Chest loot">chest loot</a> found in <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">bastion remnants</a>.</li>
<li>Available only on <a href="/w/Boots" title="Boots">boots</a>.</li>
<li>Allows faster walking on <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a> and <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a>.
<ul><li>There is a 4% chance that the durability of the boots goes down for each soul sand or soul soil block stepped on.</li></ul></li>
<li>Cannot be obtained from <a href="/w/Enchanting_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Enchanting table">enchanting tables</a>, <a href="/w/Fishing" title="Fishing">fishing</a>, or <a href="/w/Trading" title="Trading">trading</a>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Loot_table" title="Loot table">Loot tables</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a loot table for the <a href="/w/Nether_portal_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether portal block">Nether portal block</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Fire" title="Fire">Fire</a> now also has a loot table</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Material" class="mw-redirect" title="Material">Materials</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added seven new material colors:
<ul><li><span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span style="display: inline-block; background-color: #bd3031; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: 0.3em; color: transparent; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -0.36em; margin-right: -0.1em"><br></span> #bd3031</span> <code>CRIMSON_NYLIUM</code></li>
<li><span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span style="display: inline-block; background-color: #943f61; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: 0.3em; color: transparent; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -0.36em; margin-right: -0.1em"><br></span> #943f61</span> <code>CRIMSON_STEM</code></li>
<li><span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span style="display: inline-block; background-color: #5c191d; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: 0.3em; color: transparent; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -0.36em; margin-right: -0.1em"><br></span> #5c191d</span> <code>CRIMSON_HYPHAE</code></li>
<li><span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span style="display: inline-block; background-color: #167e86; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: 0.3em; color: transparent; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -0.36em; margin-right: -0.1em"><br></span> #167e86</span> <code>WARPED_NYLIUM</code></li>
<li><span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span style="display: inline-block; background-color: #3a8e8c; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: 0.3em; color: transparent; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -0.36em; margin-right: -0.1em"><br></span> #3a8e8c</span> <code>WARPED_STEM</code></li>
<li><span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span style="display: inline-block; background-color: #562c3e; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: 0.3em; color: transparent; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -0.36em; margin-right: -0.1em"><br></span> #562c3e</span> <code>WARPED_HYPHAE</code></li>
<li><span style="white-space: nowrap;"><span style="display: inline-block; background-color: #14b485; border: 1px solid #888; border-radius: 0.3em; color: transparent; width: 1em; height: 1em; vertical-align: -0.36em; margin-right: -0.1em"><br></span> #14b485</span> <code>WARPED_WART_BLOCK</code></li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Recipe_book" title="Recipe book">Recipe book</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added recipe book unlocks for <a href="/w/Smithing_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Smithing table">smithing tables</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b>Sounds</b>
</p>
<ul><li>New unique block <a href="/w/Sound" title="Sound">sounds</a> for most of the newly added blocks have been added.​<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><a href="/w/Special:TalkPage/Java_Edition_1.16" title="Special:TalkPage/Java Edition 1.16"><span title="Table of block sound with before and after" style="border-bottom: 1px dotted">more information needed</span></a></i>]</sup></li>
<li>Some blocks already in the game such as netherrack, bone blocks, and Nether bricks sounds have been changed.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Statistics" title="Statistics">Statistics</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a statistic for distance by <a href="/w/Strider" title="Strider">strider</a>.</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="General">General</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=8&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: General" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section's source code: General"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b>Accessibility</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Chat line spacing can now be adjusted.</li>
<li>A chat delay can be set between 0 (default) and 6 seconds.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Ambience" title="Ambience">Ambience</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added new ambient sounds to <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a>.
<ul><li>Different sounds play in each Nether biome.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><span style="font-family: monospace"><a href="/w/Client.json" title="Client.json">client.json</a></span> arguments</b>
</p>
<ul><li><code>disableChat</code>
<ul><li>Disables the receiving and sending of online chat.</li></ul></li>
<li><code>disableMultiplayer</code>
<ul><li>Disables the <a href="/w/Multiplayer" title="Multiplayer">Multiplayer</a> and <a href="/w/Minecraft_Realms" class="mw-redirect" title="Minecraft Realms">Minecraft Realms</a> buttons.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Customized" class="mw-redirect" title="Customized">Customized</a> worlds</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added experimental support for new custom worlds.</li>
<li>The "Edit World" menu now has an option to export world settings to a JSON file.
<ul><li>Previously exported world settings can be imported during world creation.</li></ul></li>
<li>Many new parameters are exposed but marked as experimental, meaning they can be used but may later be removed.</li></ul>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Datapack_Menu.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Datapack_Menu.png/300px-Datapack_Menu.png?471ab" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="300" height="169" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Datapack_Menu.png/600px-Datapack_Menu.png?471ab 2x" data-file-width="854" data-file-height="480"></a><figcaption>The new data pack selection menu.</figcaption></figure>
<p><b><a href="/w/Data_pack" title="Data pack">Data packs</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a new "Data Packs" button on the "Create World" screen.
<ul><li>Allows the player to select data packs to be enabled in the world.</li>
<li>Supports drag-and-drop.</li></ul></li>
<li>Dimensions and <a href="/w/Custom_dimension" class="mw-redirect" title="Custom dimension">custom dimension</a> types can now be added and changed by data packs.</li>
<li>Smithing recipes can now be added and changed by data packs.</li></ul>
<p><b><code>entity_properties</code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now has <code>vehicle</code>, and <code>targetedEntity</code> properties, which match the vehicle or the entity targeted by a mob.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Game_mode" title="Game mode">Game mode</a> toggling</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added quick game mode switching functionality using the <kbd class="key nowrap">F3</kbd> debug key.
