<ul><li>Hold <kbd class="key nowrap">F3</kbd> and press <kbd class="key nowrap">F4</kbd> to open the menu. Pressing <kbd class="key nowrap">F4</kbd> or using the mouse cycles the game mode. Release <kbd class="key nowrap">F3</kbd> to apply.</li>
<li>The last game mode is remembered and is the first selected option, so it is possible to quickly toggle between two game modes with a single press of <kbd class="key nowrap">F3</kbd> + <kbd class="key nowrap">F4</kbd>.</li>
<li><kbd class="key nowrap">F3</kbd> + <kbd class="key nowrap">N</kbd> now toggles between Spectator mode and the previous game of the player.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Graphics</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added new "<i>Fabulous!</i>"  graphics option
<ul><li>Uses per-pixel blending layers for some transparent elements.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Music" title="Music">Music</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added 3 new soundtracks to the Nether, composed by <a href="/w/Lena_Raine" title="Lena Raine">Lena Raine</a>:
<ul><li>"<a href="/w/Rubedo" title="Rubedo">Rubedo</a>" plays in the <a href="/w/Nether_wastes" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wastes">Nether wastes</a> biome.</li>
<li>"<a href="/w/Chrysopoeia" title="Chrysopoeia">Chrysopoeia</a>" plays in the <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forest</a> biome.</li>
<li>"<a href="/w/So_Below" title="So Below">So Below</a>" plays in the <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valley</a> and <a href="/w/Basalt_deltas" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt deltas">basalt deltas</a> biomes.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Options" title="Options">Options</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added an "Entity Distance" scale option ranging from 50% to 500%.
<ul><li>Sets the distance at which <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mobs</a> render into the frame.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Particles" title="Particles">Particles</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added <code>ash</code>, <code>crimson_spore</code>, <code>soul_fire_flame</code>, and <code>warped_spore</code> particles.</li>
<li>Added three particles for <a href="/w/Crying_obsidian" class="mw-redirect" title="Crying obsidian">crying obsidian</a>: <code>dripping_obsidian_tear</code>, <code>falling_obsidian_tear</code>, and <code>landing_obsidian_tear</code>.</li>
<li>Added a new particle type: <code>soul</code>.
<ul><li>Used when walking on <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a> or <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a> when wearing <a href="/w/Boots" title="Boots">boots</a> with the new <a href="/w/Soul_Speed" title="Soul Speed">Soul Speed</a> enchantment.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Settings" title="Settings">Settings</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added functionality to import/export world settings.</li></ul>
<p><b>Shaders</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added <code>assets\minecraft\shaders\post\transparency.json</code>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Splash" title="Splash">Splash</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added new splashes:
<ul><li>This parrot is no more! It has ceased to be!</li>
<li>Honey, I grew the bees!</li>
<li>Find your claw!</li>
<li>Everybody do the Leif!</li>
<li><3 Max & 99 & Ducky!</li>
<li>Bushy eyebrows!</li>
<li>Edit is a name!</li>
<li>From free range developers!</li>
<li>Music by <a href="/w/Lena_Raine" title="Lena Raine">Lena Raine</a>!</li>
<li>Aww man!</li>
<li>#minecraftfarms</li>
<li>And my pickaxe!</li>
<li>Envision! Create! Share!</li>
<li><a href="/w/Graphics_setting" class="mw-redirect" title="Graphics setting">Fabulous graphics</a>!</li>
<li>Also try <a href="/w/Minecraft_Dungeons" title="Minecraft Dungeons">Minecraft Dungeons</a>!</li>
<li>Vanilla!</li>
<li>May contain traces of citrus!</li>
<li><a href="/w/Zoglin" title="Zoglin">Zoglin</a>!?</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Sound_events" class="mw-redirect" title="Sound events">Sound events</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a new sound event for <a href="/w/Fox" title="Fox">foxes</a> teleporting after eating a <a href="/w/Chorus_fruit" class="mw-redirect" title="Chorus fruit">chorus fruit</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Subtitles" class="mw-redirect" title="Subtitles">Subtitles</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a subtitle for traveling through a <a href="/w/Nether_portal" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether portal">Nether portal</a>, "Portal noise fades".</li>
<li>Added a subtitle for activating a Nether portal, "Portal noise intensifies".</li>
<li>Added a subtitle for <a href="/w/Cat" title="Cat">cat</a> purring, "Cat purrs".</li>
<li>Added a subtitle for <a href="/w/Donkey" title="Donkey">donkey</a> eating, "Donkey eats".</li>
<li>Added a subtitle for <a href="/w/Fox" title="Fox">fox</a> teleporting, "Fox teleports".</li>
<li>Added subtitles for <a href="/w/Mule" title="Mule">mules</a> neighing and eating; "Mule neighs" and "Mule eats", respectively.</li>
<li>Added subtitles for <a href="/w/Parrot" title="Parrot">parrots</a> imitating <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglins</a>, <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a>, and <a href="/w/Zoglin" title="Zoglin">zoglins</a>; "Parrot growls", "Parrot snorts", and "Parrot growls", respectively.</li>
<li>Added subtitles for <a href="/w/Zombie" title="Zombie">zombies</a> attacking and breaking wooden <a href="/w/Door" title="Door">doors</a>; "Door shakes" and "Door breaks", respectively.</li>
<li>Added subtitles for using <a href="/w/Cartography_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Cartography table">cartography tables</a>, <a href="/w/Loom" title="Loom">looms</a>, and <a href="/w/Stonecutter" title="Stonecutter">stonecutters</a>; "Map drawn", "Loom used", and "Stonecutter used", respectively.</li>
<li>Several of these subtitles do not show up in game, but are specified in <span style="font-family: monospace"><a href="/w/Sounds.json" title="Sounds.json">sounds.json</a></span>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Tag" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">Tags</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">block</a> tag <code>beacon_base_blocks</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Block_of_diamond" class="mw-redirect" title="Block of diamond">block of diamond</a>, <a href="/w/Block_of_emerald" class="mw-redirect" title="Block of emerald">block of emerald</a>, <a href="/w/Block_of_gold" class="mw-redirect" title="Block of gold">block of gold</a>, <a href="/w/Block_of_iron" class="mw-redirect" title="Block of iron">block of iron</a>, and <a href="/w/Block_of_netherite" class="mw-redirect" title="Block of netherite">block of netherite</a>.</li>
<li>Controls what blocks can be used to build a <a href="/w/Beacon" title="Beacon">beacon</a> base.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added item tag <code>beacon_payment_items</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Diamond" title="Diamond">diamond</a>, <a href="/w/Emerald" title="Emerald">emerald</a>, <a href="/w/Gold_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Gold ingot">gold ingot</a>, <a href="/w/Iron_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Iron ingot">iron ingot</a>, and <a href="/w/Netherite_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite ingot">netherite ingot</a>.</li>
<li>Controls what <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">items</a> can be used as payment in a <a href="/w/Beacon" title="Beacon">beacon</a>'s GUI.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>campfires</code>.
<ul><li>Contains campfires and soul campfires.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Bee" title="Bee">Bees</a>, <a href="/w/Parrot" title="Parrot">parrots</a>, and <a href="/w/Turtle" title="Turtle">turtles</a> view blocks in this tag as dealing fire damage and pathfind accordingly.</li>
<li>Campfires use this tag to determine if they are lit or not.</li>
<li>Flint and steel & fire charges use this tag to determine if they can light campfires.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>climbable</code>.
<ul><li>Includes <a href="/w/Ladder" title="Ladder">ladders</a>, <a href="/w/Scaffolding" title="Scaffolding">scaffolding</a>, <a href="/w/Twisting_vines" class="mw-redirect" title="Twisting vines">twisting vines</a>, <a href="/w/Vines" title="Vines">vines</a>, and <a href="/w/Weeping_vines" class="mw-redirect" title="Weeping vines">weeping vines</a>.</li>
<li>Used in <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mob</a> pathfinding and to determine what blocks the player can climb.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added item tag <code>creeper_drop_music_discs</code>.
<ul><li>Contains all music discs except "<a href="/w/Pigstep" class="mw-redirect" title="Pigstep">Pigstep</a>".</li>
<li>Used to determine what music discs creepers can drop.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block and item tags <code>crimson_stems</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Crimson_stem" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson stem">crimson stem</a>, <a href="/w/Stripped_crimson_stem" class="mw-redirect" title="Stripped crimson stem">stripped crimson stem</a>, <a href="/w/Crimson_hyphae" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson hyphae">crimson hyphae</a> and <a href="/w/Stripped_crimson_hyphae" class="mw-redirect" title="Stripped crimson hyphae">stripped crimson hyphae</a>.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>fence_gates</code>.
<ul><li>Contains all 8 fence gate types.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>fire</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Fire" title="Fire">fire</a> and <a href="/w/Soul_fire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul fire">soul fire</a>.</li>
<li>Used in defining various fire-related behaviors, such as mob pathfinding and splash water extinguishing.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added item tag <code>furnace_materials</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Blackstone" title="Blackstone">blackstone</a> and <a href="/w/Cobblestone" title="Cobblestone">cobblestone</a>.</li>
<li>Items in this tag can be used to craft furnaces and unlock the recipe in the recipe book.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block and item tag <code>gold_ores</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Gold_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Gold ore">gold ore</a> and <a href="/w/Nether_gold_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether gold ore">Nether gold ore</a>.</li>
<li>Many <a href="/w/Recipe" class="mw-disambig" title="Recipe">recipes</a> use this tag.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>guarded_by_piglins</code>.
<ul><li>Contains container blocks such as (<a href="/w/Barrel" title="Barrel">barrels</a>, <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chests</a>, <a href="/w/Ender_chest" class="mw-redirect" title="Ender chest">ender chests</a>, the <code><a href="/w/Tag#blocks_shulker_boxes" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">shulker_boxes</a></code> block tag, and <a href="/w/Trapped_chest" class="mw-redirect" title="Trapped chest">trapped chests</a>), as well as <a href="/w/Gilded_blackstone" class="mw-redirect" title="Gilded blackstone">gilded blackstone</a>, gold blocks (<a href="/w/Blocks_of_gold" class="mw-redirect" title="Blocks of gold">blocks of gold</a>, and the <code><a href="/w/Tag#blocks_gold_ores" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">gold_ores</a></code> block tag).</li>
<li><a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">Piglins</a> become hostile toward a player that destroys a block in this tag.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>hoglin_repellents</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Nether_portal" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether portal">Nether portals</a>, <a href="/w/Respawn_anchor" class="mw-redirect" title="Respawn anchor">respawn anchors</a>, and <a href="/w/Warped_fungus" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped fungus">warped fungus</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">Hoglins</a> avoid blocks in this tag.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added entity tag <code>impact_projectiles</code>.
<ul><li>Includes the <a href="/w/Tag#entity_types_arrows" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">arrows</a> tag, dragon fireballs, <a href="/w/Egg" title="Egg">eggs</a>, <a href="/w/Fireball" title="Fireball">fireballs</a>, small fireballs, <a href="/w/Snowball" title="Snowball">snowballs</a>, <a href="/w/Trident" title="Trident">tridents</a>, and <a href="/w/Wither#Wither_Skull" title="Wither">wither skulls</a>.</li>
<li>Used to determine what <a href="/w/Entities" class="mw-redirect" title="Entities">entities</a> break <a href="/w/Chorus_fruit" class="mw-redirect" title="Chorus fruit">chorus fruit</a> when hit.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>infiniburn_end</code>.
<ul><li>Contains the <code>#infiniburn_overworld</code> block tag as well as bedrock.</li>
<li>Fire burns infinitely on blocks in this tag in the End.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>infiniburn_nether</code>.
<ul><li>Contains the <code>#infiniburn_overworld</code> block tag.</li>
<li>Fire burns infinitely on blocks in this tag in the Nether.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>infiniburn_overworld</code>.
<ul><li>Contains netherrack and magma blocks.</li>
<li>Fire burns infinitely on blocks in this tag in the Overworld.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block and item tag <code>logs_that_burn</code>.
<ul><li>Contains the <code>dark_oak_logs</code>, <code>oak_logs</code>, <code>acacia_logs</code>, <code>birch_logs</code>, <code>jungle_logs</code>, and <code>spruce_logs</code> block and item tags, respectively.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block and item tag <code>non_flammable_wood</code>.
<ul><li>Contains crimson and warped stems, hyphae, planks, and other woodblocks, as well as stripped variants where applicable.</li>
<li>Items in the item tag cannot be used as fuel in a furnace.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>nylium</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Crimson_nylium" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson nylium">crimson nylium</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_nylium" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped nylium">warped nylium</a>.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added item tag <code>piglin_loved</code>.
<ul><li>Contains gold ingots, gold tools, gold armor, golden apples, enchanted golden apples, golden horse armor, golden carrots, blocks of gold, the <code>gold_ores</code> item tag, gilded blackstone, light weighted pressure plates, bells, glistering melon slices, and clocks.</li>
<li>Piglins "love" items in this tag, meaning they actively seek them out. They also view players holding an item in this tag as holding a "loved" item.</li>
<li>Used in the "Oh Shiny" advancement.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block and item tag <code>piglin_repellents</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Soul_campfire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul campfire">soul campfires</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_fire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul fire">soul fire</a>, <a href="/w/Soul_lantern" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul lantern">soul lanterns</a>, and <a href="/w/Soul_torch" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul torch">soul torches</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">Piglins</a> avoid, and don't attempt to pick up, blocks and items in this tag.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>pressure_plates</code>
<ul><li>Contains light and heavy weighted pressure plates, as well as the <code><a href="/w/Tag#blocks_stone_pressure_plates" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">#stone_pressure_plates</a></code> and <code><a href="/w/Tag#blocks_wooden_pressure_plates" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">#wooden_pressure_plates</a></code> block tags.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>prevent_mob_spawning_inside</code>.
<ul><li>Contains the <code><a href="/w/Tag#blocks_rails" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">#rails</a></code> block tag.</li>
<li>Mobs cannot spawn in blocks in this tag.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block and item tag <code>soul_fire_base_blocks</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a> and <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a>.</li>
<li>Determines what blocks can support <a href="/w/Soul_fire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul fire">soul fire</a>.</li>
<li>Items in this tag can be used to craft <a href="/w/Soul_campfire" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul campfire">soul campfires</a> and <a href="/w/Soul_torch" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul torch">soul torches</a> and unlock the recipes in the recipe book.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>soul_speed_blocks</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a> and <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a>.</li>
<li>The <a href="/w/Soul_Speed" title="Soul Speed">Soul Speed</a> enchantment uses this tag to test for which blocks increase speed.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>stone_pressure_plates</code>
<ul><li>Contains stone and polished blackstone pressure plates.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added item tag <code>stone_tool_materials</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Cobblestone" title="Cobblestone">cobblestone</a> and <a href="/w/Blackstone" title="Blackstone">blackstone</a>.</li>
<li>Items in this tag can be used to craft stone tools and unlock the recipes in the recipe book.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>strider_warm_blocks</code>.
<ul><li>Contains lava.</li>
<li>Unless a strider is in a block in this tag, it turns purple and shiver.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>unstable_bottom_center</code>.
<ul><li>Contains the <code>#fence_gates</code> block tag.</li>
<li>Blocks in this tag cannot support lanterns or bells on their bottom side even if they would otherwise be able to.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>wall_post_override</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Banner" title="Banner">banners</a>, <a href="/w/Pressure_plate" class="mw-redirect" title="Pressure plate">pressure plates</a>, <a href="/w/Redstone_torch" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone torch">redstone torches</a>, <code><a href="/w/Tag#blocks_signs" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">#signs</a></code>, <a href="/w/Soul_torch" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul torch">soul torches</a>, <a href="/w/Tripwire" class="mw-redirect" title="Tripwire">tripwire</a>, and <a href="/w/Torch" title="Torch">torches</a>.</li>
<li>Controls what non-solid blocks can transform <a href="/w/Wall" title="Wall">walls</a> into their pillared block state.​<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><a href="/w/Special:TalkPage/Java_Edition_1.16" title="Special:TalkPage/Java Edition 1.16"><span title="if these blocks are removed form this tag, do walls still pillar up for any of them?" style="border-bottom: 1px dotted">more information needed</span></a></i>]</sup></li></ul></li>
<li>Added block and item tags <code>warped_stems</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Stripped_warped_hyphae" class="mw-redirect" title="Stripped warped hyphae">stripped warped hyphae</a>, <a href="/w/Stripped_warped_stem" class="mw-redirect" title="Stripped warped stem">stripped warped stem</a>, <a href="/w/Warped_hyphae" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped hyphae">warped hyphae</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_stem" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped stem">warped stem</a>.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>wart_blocks</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart block</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped wart block">warped wart block</a>.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added block tag <code>wither_summon_base_blocks</code>.
<ul><li>Contains <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a> and <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a>.</li>
<li>Controls what blocks can be used to build a <a href="/w/Wither" title="Wither">wither</a>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Text</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added text which was missing for two <a href="/w/Death_message" class="mw-redirect" title="Death message">death messages</a> and were displaying raw translation strings.<sup id="cite_ref-8" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-8"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>8<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-9" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-9"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>9<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul>
<p><b>World creation</b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Difficulty" title="Difficulty">Difficulty</a> and <a href="/w/Game_rule" title="Game rule">game rules</a> can now be changed from the "Create World" screen.</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Changes">Changes</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=9&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Changes" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section's source code: Changes"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Blocks_2">Blocks</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=10&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Blocks" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=10" title="Edit section's source code: Blocks"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b><a href="/w/Bamboo_sapling" class="mw-redirect" title="Bamboo sapling">Bamboo saplings</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Renamed to "Bamboo Shoot".</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Beacon" title="Beacon">Beacons</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Netherite_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite block">Netherite blocks</a> can be used as the base of a beacon.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Netherite_ingot" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite ingot">Netherite ingots</a> can be used to select powers from a beacon.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Bell" title="Bell">Bells</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now rings when hit by any type of <a href="/w/Projectile" title="Projectile">projectile</a>.</li>
<li>Now follow the same placement rules as <a href="/w/Lantern" title="Lantern">lanterns</a> when being placed on the undersides of blocks. As a result they can now be hung from the bottom of the following blocks:
<ul><li><a href="/w/Anvil" title="Anvil">Anvils</a> (all stages)</li>
<li><a href="/w/Brewing_stand" class="mw-redirect" title="Brewing stand">Brewing stands</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Iron_Chain" title="Iron Chain">Chains</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">Chests</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Ender_chest" class="mw-redirect" title="Ender chest">Ender chests</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/End_rod" class="mw-redirect" title="End rod">End rods</a> (facing up or down)</li>
<li><a href="/w/Fence" title="Fence">Fences</a> (all types)</li>
<li><a href="/w/Flower_pot" class="mw-redirect" title="Flower pot">Flower pots</a> (including potted objects)</li>
<li><a href="/w/Glass_pane" class="mw-redirect" title="Glass pane">Glass panes</a> (including stained)</li>
<li><a href="/w/Grindstone" title="Grindstone">Grindstones</a> (ceiling attached)</li>
<li><a href="/w/Hopper" title="Hopper">Hoppers</a> (downward facing)</li>
<li><a href="/w/Iron_bars" class="mw-redirect" title="Iron bars">Iron bars</a></li>
<li>Mob <a href="/w/Head" title="Head">heads</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Piston" title="Piston">Pistons</a> (sideways facing extended)</li>
<li><a href="/w/Trapped_chest" class="mw-redirect" title="Trapped chest">Trapped chests</a></li>
<li><a href="/w/Wall" title="Wall">Walls</a> (all types)</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Bone_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone block">Bone blocks</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Generate as part of <a href="/w/Nether_fossil" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether fossil">Nether fossils</a> in <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valleys</a>.</li>
<li>Now have their own <a href="/w/Sound" title="Sound">sound</a>, instead of using the default <a href="/w/Stone" title="Stone">stone</a> sound.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Campfire" title="Campfire">Campfires</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be crafted using crimson and warped <a href="/w/Log" title="Log">stems</a>.</li>
<li>Now ignites when hit by any burning projectile.</li>
<li>Now drop food being cooked when put out with a shovel or water bottle.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">Composter</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now allows for <a href="/w/Nether_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether fungi">Nether fungi</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_sprouts" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether sprouts">Nether sprouts</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_wart" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart">Nether wart</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart blocks</a>, <a href="/w/Crimson_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson roots">crimson roots</a>, <a href="/w/Warped_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped roots">warped roots</a>, <a href="/w/Twisting_vines" class="mw-redirect" title="Twisting vines">twisting vines</a>, <a href="/w/Warped_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped wart block">warped wart blocks</a>, <a href="/w/Weeping_vines" class="mw-redirect" title="Weeping vines">weeping vines</a>, and <a href="/w/Shroomlight" title="Shroomlight">shroomlights</a> to be composted.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Dispenser" title="Dispenser">Dispensers</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now saddle <a href="/w/Pig" title="Pig">pigs</a>, <a href="/w/Strider" title="Strider">striders</a>, and tamed <a href="/w/Horse" title="Horse">horses</a>, <a href="/w/Donkey" title="Donkey">donkeys</a>, and <a href="/w/Mule" title="Mule">mules</a>.</li>
<li>Can now put <a href="/w/Horse_armor" class="mw-redirect" title="Horse armor">horse armor</a> on tamed horses.</li>
<li>Can now put <a href="/w/Carpet" title="Carpet">carpets</a> on tamed <a href="/w/Llama" title="Llama">llamas</a>.</li>
<li>Can now put <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chests</a> on tamed llamas, donkeys, and mules.</li>
<li>Can now shear <a href="/w/Mooshroom" title="Mooshroom">mooshrooms</a> and <a href="/w/Snow_golem" class="mw-redirect" title="Snow golem">snow golems</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Fire" title="Fire">Fire</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now has a proper hitbox (<sup>1</sup>⁄<sub>16</sub> <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a>).</li>
<li>Cannot be put out by <a href="/w/Sword" title="Sword">swords</a> or <a href="/w/Trident" title="Trident">tridents</a> in <a href="/w/Creative" title="Creative">Creative</a> mode, akin to other <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a>, and can be modified via the <a href="/w/Debug_stick" class="mw-redirect" title="Debug stick">debug stick</a>.</li>
<li>Now has <a href="/w/Loot_table" title="Loot table">loot tables</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Flower_pot" class="mw-redirect" title="Flower pot">Flower pots</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Has a bottom texture when empty.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Furnace" title="Furnace">Furnaces</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be crafted with <a href="/w/Blackstone" title="Blackstone">blackstone</a>.</li>
<li>Breaking a furnace now gives the experience for the smelted things inside.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Gravel" title="Gravel">Gravel</a> and <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Generate in the new <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valley</a> biome.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Jigsaw_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Jigsaw block">Jigsaw blocks</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can have one of 12 orientations.</li>
<li>Added new property <code>Joint type</code> to describe if attached piece can be rotated (<code>rollable</code>) or not (<code>aligned</code>).</li>
<li>NBT field <code>target_pool</code> has been renamed to <code>pool</code>.</li>
<li><code>attachement_type</code> has been split into <code>name</code> (on parent block) and <code>target</code> (on child block).</li>
<li>Added a locked texture <span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Jigsaw_Block_(S)_JE3_BE2.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Jigsaw_Block_%28S%29_JE3_BE2.png/32px-Jigsaw_Block_%28S%29_JE3_BE2.png?9e6a3" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Jigsaw_Block_%28S%29_JE3_BE2.png/64px-Jigsaw_Block_%28S%29_JE3_BE2.png?9e6a3 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span>.</li>
<li>Added a button in the GUI that generates a jigsaw structure starting from the jigsaw block, using a given generation depth.</li>
<li>Added a new "Keep Jigsaws" option that controls whether jigsaw blocks in the resulting structure after using "Generate" remain jigsaw blocks or are replaced by their "Turns Into" block.
<ul><li>Defaults to "ON".</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">Lava</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now pushes <a href="/w/Entities" class="mw-redirect" title="Entities">entities</a>.</li>
<li>Now has a proper hitbox, making flowing lava blocks not full blocks anymore.</li>
<li>Visibility under lava is now slightly better when under the effect of <a href="/w/Fire_Resistance" title="Fire Resistance">Fire Resistance</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Nether_portal_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether portal block">Nether portal block</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now has an associated loot table.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Netherrack" title="Netherrack">Netherrack</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Using <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">bone meal</a> on <a href="/w/Netherrack" title="Netherrack">netherrack</a> adjacent to <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a> converts the netherrack into nylium.
<ul><li>If two nylium blocks of different types are present, it chooses the type at random based on how many <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a> of each type are around it.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart blocks</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Generate as a part of <a href="/w/Huge_crimson_fungi" class="mw-redirect" title="Huge crimson fungi">huge crimson fungi</a>. Sometimes generates in the ground replacing the <a href="/w/Crimson_nylium" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson nylium">crimson nylium</a> in the <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forest</a> biome.</li>
<li>Texture changed from <span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Nether_Wart_Block_JE2_BE2.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Nether_Wart_Block_JE2_BE2.png/32px-Nether_Wart_Block_JE2_BE2.png?79337" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Nether_Wart_Block_JE2_BE2.png/64px-Nether_Wart_Block_JE2_BE2.png?79337 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span> to <span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Nether_Wart_Block_JE3.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Nether_Wart_Block_JE3.png/32px-Nether_Wart_Block_JE3.png?2555f" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Nether_Wart_Block_JE3.png/64px-Nether_Wart_Block_JE3.png?2555f 2x" data-file-width="300" data-file-height="300"></a></span>.</li>
<li>Changed the texture to match the texture in <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>.</li>
<li>Can now be used in <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composters</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Observer" title="Observer">Observers</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now allow the placing of <a href="/w/Ladder" title="Ladder">ladders</a> and <a href="/w/Tripwire_hook" class="mw-redirect" title="Tripwire hook">tripwire hooks</a>.</li>
<li>The back texture while powered on has been changed.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Piston" title="Piston">Pistons</a> and <a href="/w/Sticky_piston" class="mw-redirect" title="Sticky piston">sticky pistons</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Hardness has been increased to 1.5.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Pickaxe" title="Pickaxe">Pickaxes</a> are now more effective on pistons.<sup id="cite_ref-10" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-10"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>10<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Pistons can now support non-solid <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a> on its top face without them popping off when the piston retracts (<a href="/w/Torch" title="Torch">torches</a>, <a href="/w/Lever" title="Lever">levers</a>, <a href="/w/Button" title="Button">buttons</a>, etc.).<sup id="cite_ref-11" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-11"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>11<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Potted_cactus" class="mw-redirect" title="Potted cactus">Potted cactus</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Top face now uses the top texture of cactus, rather than the side texture.</li>
<li>Now no longer contains dirt.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Purpur_pillar" class="mw-redirect" title="Purpur pillar">Purpur pillars</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed the top texture to match the texture in <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Redstone_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone block">Redstone blocks</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now allow the placing of <a href="/w/Ladder" title="Ladder">ladders</a> and <a href="/w/Tripwire_hook" class="mw-redirect" title="Tripwire hook">tripwire hooks</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Redstone_dust" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone dust">Redstone dust</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now has a bottom texture.</li>
<li>A single redstone wire is now represented as a cross.
<ul><li>Interacting with an isolated redstone toggles it between a cross and a dot.
<ul><li>A dot of redstone does not power surrounding blocks, and a cross does.</li>
<li>Redstone which is connected to anything is not toggleable.</li></ul></li></ul></li>
<li>Redstone provides power to blocks on sides it shows a visual connection to, and not do so on those sides without a visual connection.</li>
<li>A wire on top of a block, which is redirected from below, now powers the sides it is redirected to.
<ul><li>Wires that redirect upward to wires on non-conductive blocks used to be redirected only visually; now this redirection applies to their behavior as well.</li></ul></li>
<li>A wire that is redirected to go over a block now always provides power to the block. This is most noticeable when the wire has signal strength 1.</li>
<li>Redstone dust's hitbox now better adjusts to its shape.</li>
<li>Now visually connects when traveling up <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a>, 8-layer <a href="/w/Snow" title="Snow">snow</a> stacks and the back of upside-down <a href="/w/Stairs" title="Stairs">stairs</a>.</li>
<li>Particles are now generated across the entire area of the redstone wire; previously they appeared only at the center.
<ul><li>This now causes the particles to appear at the incorrect positions when millions of blocks away from the spawn point, due to precision loss<sup id="cite_ref-12" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-12"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>12<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> (see <a href="/w/Java_Edition_distance_effects" title="Java Edition distance effects">Java Edition distance effects</a>).</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Sign" title="Sign">Signs</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed the capitalization of "Edit sign message" to "Edit Sign Message" in the sign GUI.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Smithing_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Smithing table">Smithing tables</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added functionality: it is used to upgrade diamond <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">items</a> into their respective <a href="/w/Netherite" class="mw-disambig" title="Netherite">netherite</a> variations.
<ul><li><a href="/w/Enchantment" title="Enchantment">Enchantments</a> on the diamond item are preserved when upgrading into netherite.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Smoker" title="Smoker">Smokers</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be crafted using crimson or warped <a href="/w/Planks" title="Planks">planks</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Smooth_quartz" class="mw-redirect" title="Smooth quartz">Smooth quartz</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Renamed to "smooth quartz block".</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Snow" title="Snow">Snow</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Button" title="Button">Buttons</a>, <a href="/w/Door" title="Door">doors</a>, <a href="/w/Pressure_plate" class="mw-redirect" title="Pressure plate">pressure plates</a>, <a href="/w/Rail" title="Rail">rails</a>, <a href="/w/Redstone_dust" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone dust">redstone dust</a>, and <a href="/w/Torch" title="Torch">torches</a> can now be placed on a full-<a href="/w/Block" title="Block">block</a> of snow layers.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">Soul sand</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Soul sand with a <a href="/w/Rail" title="Rail">rail</a> on top no longer slows down <a href="/w/Minecart" title="Minecart">minecarts</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Button" title="Button">Buttons</a>, <a href="/w/Door" title="Door">doors</a>, <a href="/w/Pressure_plate" class="mw-redirect" title="Pressure plate">pressure plates</a>, <a href="/w/Rail" title="Rail">rails</a>, <a href="/w/Redstone_dust" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone dust">redstone dust</a>, and <a href="/w/Torch" title="Torch">torches</a> can now be placed on it.</li>
<li>Walking/running speed on soul sand now can be sped up if wearing <a href="/w/Soul_Speed" title="Soul Speed">Soul Speed</a> boots.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Structure_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Structure block">Structure blocks</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Expanded the maximum size per axis from 32 to 48, to accommodate the new <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">bastion remnants</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/TNT" title="TNT">TNT</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now ignites when hit by any burning projectile.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Vines" title="Vines">Vines</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now play a <a href="/w/Sound" title="Sound">sound</a> when climbed.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Wall" title="Wall">Walls</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Walls in the middle of a row have longer pillars when stacked vertically.
<ul><li><a href="/w/Block_state" class="mw-redirect" title="Block state">Block state</a> now uses <code>none</code>, <code>low</code>, and <code>tall</code> for <code>east</code>, <code>west</code>, <code>north</code>, and <code>south</code> directional values.</li></ul></li>
<li>Now connect to the bottom and sides of <a href="/w/Glass_pane" class="mw-redirect" title="Glass pane">glass panes</a> and <a href="/w/Iron_bars" class="mw-redirect" title="Iron bars">iron bars</a>.</li>
<li>Now connect to the bottom of <a href="/w/Sea_pickle" class="mw-redirect" title="Sea pickle">sea pickles</a>.</li>
<li>Now change into posts when <a href="/w/Pressure_plate" class="mw-redirect" title="Pressure plate">pressure plates</a> and <a href="/w/Banner" title="Banner">banners</a> are placed on them.</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Items_2">Items</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=11&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Items" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=11" title="Edit section's source code: Items"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b><a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">Bone meal</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be used to grow <a href="/w/Kelp" title="Kelp">kelp</a>, <a href="/w/Twisting_vines" class="mw-redirect" title="Twisting vines">twisting vines</a>, and <a href="/w/Weeping_vines" class="mw-redirect" title="Weeping vines">weeping vines</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Nether_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether fungi">Nether fungi</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_sprouts" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether sprouts">Nether sprouts</a>, <a href="/w/Crimson_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson roots">crimson roots</a>, and <a href="/w/Warped_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped roots">warped roots</a>; now grow on <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a> if bone meal is used on a nylium block.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Charcoal" title="Charcoal">Charcoal</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be smelted only from items in the <code>logs_that_burn</code> block tag.
<ul><li>This change does not affect gameplay, as the new tag contains only items charcoal could be smelted from.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Clay_Ball" title="Clay Ball">Clay</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Renamed to "Clay Ball".</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Compass" title="Compass">Compass</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be enchanted with <a href="/w/Curse_of_Vanishing" title="Curse of Vanishing">Curse of Vanishing</a>.</li>
<li>Can now be used on the new <a href="/w/Lodestone" title="Lodestone">lodestone</a> block as a waypoint.
<ul><li>The compass now has <code>LodestonePos</code>, <code>LodestoneDimension</code>, and <code>LodestoneTracked</code> data fields. If <code>LodestoneTracked</code> is zero, game skips checking for a lodestone in the specified position.</li></ul></li>
<li>Now points to the center of the spawn point block instead of its northwest corner.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Diamond_axe" class="mw-redirect" title="Diamond axe">Diamond axe</a>, <a href="/w/Diamond_boots" class="mw-redirect" title="Diamond boots">diamond boots</a>, <a href="/w/Diamond_helmet" class="mw-redirect" title="Diamond helmet">diamond helmet</a>, <a href="/w/Diamond_hoe" class="mw-redirect" title="Diamond hoe">diamond hoe</a>, <a href="/w/Diamond_leggings" class="mw-redirect" title="Diamond leggings">diamond leggings</a>, <a href="/w/Diamond_pickaxe" class="mw-redirect" title="Diamond pickaxe">diamond pickaxe</a>, <a href="/w/Diamond_shovel" class="mw-redirect" title="Diamond shovel">diamond shovel</a>, <a href="/w/Diamond_sword" class="mw-redirect" title="Diamond sword">diamond sword</a>, <a href="/w/Golden_hoe" class="mw-redirect" title="Golden hoe">golden hoe</a>, <a href="/w/Golden_pickaxe" class="mw-redirect" title="Golden pickaxe">golden pickaxe</a>, <a href="/w/Wooden_hoe" class="mw-redirect" title="Wooden hoe">wooden hoe</a>, and <a href="/w/Wooden_pickaxe" class="mw-redirect" title="Wooden pickaxe">wooden pickaxe</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed their textures slightly.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Food" title="Food">Food</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be placed on unlit <a href="/w/Campfire" title="Campfire">campfires</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Hoe" title="Hoe">Hoes</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be enchanted with <a href="/w/Efficiency" title="Efficiency">Efficiency</a>, <a href="/w/Fortune" title="Fortune">Fortune</a> and <a href="/w/Silk_Touch" title="Silk Touch">Silk Touch</a>.</li>
<li>Now mine <a href="/w/Sponge" title="Sponge">sponges</a>, <a href="/w/Wet_sponge" class="mw-redirect" title="Wet sponge">wet sponges</a>, <a href="/w/Dried_kelp_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Dried kelp block">dried kelp blocks</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart blocks</a>, <a href="/w/Target" title="Target">targets</a>, <a href="/w/Shroomlight" title="Shroomlight">shroomlights</a>, <a href="/w/Leaves" title="Leaves">leaves</a>, and <a href="/w/Hay_bale" class="mw-redirect" title="Hay bale">hay bales</a> faster than other <a href="/w/Tool" title="Tool">tools</a>.
<ul><li>Mining with a hoe does not cause leaves to drop like mining with <a href="/w/Shears" title="Shears">shears</a> does.</li>
<li>As hoes can now be enchanted with Fortune or Silk Touch, these enchantments now affect leaves when mined with a hoe.</li></ul></li>
<li>Each tier has different speed at which hoes mine <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a> they are effective against.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Map" title="Map">Maps</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Map making sounds are now same as when using <a href="/w/Cartography_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Cartography table">cartography tables</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Spawn_egg" class="mw-redirect" title="Spawn egg">Spawn eggs</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Using a spawn egg on a <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mob</a> that does not have a baby variant now spawns an adult of that mob type.</li></ul>
<p><b>Stone <a href="/w/Axe" title="Axe">axes</a>, <a href="/w/Hoe" title="Hoe">hoes</a>, <a href="/w/Pickaxe" title="Pickaxe">pickaxes</a>, <a href="/w/Shovel" title="Shovel">shovels</a>, and <a href="/w/Sword" title="Sword">swords</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be crafted with blackstone.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Water_bucket" class="mw-redirect" title="Water bucket">Water buckets</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be obtained in <a href="/w/Creative" title="Creative">Creative</a> mode when an empty bucket is used on water.
<ul><li>If a bucket of water is in the player’s inventory already, no additional water buckets are added when an empty bucket is used on water.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Zombie pigman <a href="/w/Spawn_egg" class="mw-redirect" title="Spawn egg">spawn eggs</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Renamed to zombified piglin spawn egg.</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Mobs_2">Mobs</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=12&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Mobs" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=12" title="Edit section's source code: Mobs"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<figure typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Revamped_anger_management_for_neutral_mobs_in_minecraft.jpg" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Revamped_anger_management_for_neutral_mobs_in_minecraft.jpg/340px-Revamped_anger_management_for_neutral_mobs_in_minecraft.jpg?f9b32" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="340" height="352" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Revamped_anger_management_for_neutral_mobs_in_minecraft.jpg/680px-Revamped_anger_management_for_neutral_mobs_in_minecraft.jpg?f9b32 2x" data-file-width="3929" data-file-height="4071"></a><figcaption>The revamped anger management for neutral mobs in minecraft</figcaption></figure>
<p><b>General</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now avoid walking on magma blocks and lit campfires.</li>
<li>Mobs except <a href="/w/Wither_skeleton" class="mw-redirect" title="Wither skeleton">wither skeletons</a> can no longer spawn within <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a> occupied by a <a href="/w/Wither_rose" class="mw-redirect" title="Wither rose">wither rose</a>.</li>
<li>Spawning has been tweaked to more closely follow mob caps.
<ul><li>Mobs in <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valleys</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">warped forests</a> create a radius around them that prevents other mobs of the same type from spawning, which gets bigger as more mobs spawn.</li></ul></li>
<li>Players can no longer mount another entity when the crouch key is held down.</li>
<li>The neutral mob NBT tag <code>AngryAt</code> is now used when the mob is angry at any entity, not just players.</li>
<li>Mobs that are riders of other mobs and entities no longer <a href="/w/Despawn" class="mw-redirect" title="Despawn">despawn</a>.
<ul><li>Therefore, passengers of <a href="/w/Boat" title="Boat">boats</a> and <a href="/w/Minecart" title="Minecart">minecarts</a> no longer despawn.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Bee" title="Bee">Bees</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>The maximum distance a <a href="/w/Bee" title="Bee">bee</a> can wander away from its home <a href="/w/Hive" class="mw-redirect" title="Hive">hive</a> when randomly wandering has been reduced to around 22 <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a>.</li>
<li>Now grow up and count down their breeding cool down when inside a beehive.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Cow" title="Cow">Cows</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be milked in <a href="/w/Creative" title="Creative">Creative</a> mode.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Endermen" class="mw-redirect" title="Endermen">Endermen</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now spawn in <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valleys</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped forest">warped forests</a>.</li>
<li>Can now pick up <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a>, <a href="/w/Crimson_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson roots">crimson roots</a>, <a href="/w/Warped_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped roots">warped roots</a>, and <a href="/w/Nether_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether fungi">Nether fungi</a> variants.</li>
<li>No longer pick up <a href="/w/Netherrack" title="Netherrack">netherrack</a>.</li>
<li>No longer despawn when holding a block.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Fish" title="Fish">Fish</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now despawn when they are further than 64 blocks away from the closest <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>.
<ul><li>Does not apply to fish placed or <a href="/w/Name_Tag" title="Name Tag">named</a> by the player.<sup id="cite_ref-13" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-13"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>13<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul></li>
<li>Now have their own mob category and mob cap.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Ghast" title="Ghast">Ghasts</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Sounds are now heard at a shorter range.</li>
<li>Now spawn in <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valleys</a> and <a href="/w/Basalt_deltas" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt deltas">basalt deltas</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Mooshroom" title="Mooshroom">Mooshrooms</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be milked in <a href="/w/Creative" title="Creative">Creative</a> mode.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Mushroom_stew" class="mw-redirect" title="Mushroom stew">Mushroom stew</a> and <a href="/w/Suspicious_stew" class="mw-redirect" title="Suspicious stew">suspicious stew</a> can now be obtained in Creative mode.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Iron_golem" class="mw-redirect" title="Iron golem">Iron golems</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Villager" title="Villager">Villagers</a> can now spawn iron golems regardless of their profession status or latest working time.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Magma_cube" class="mw-redirect" title="Magma cube">Magma cubes</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now spawn commonly in <a href="/w/Basalt_deltas" class="mw-redirect" title="Basalt deltas">basalt deltas</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Parrot" title="Parrot">Parrots</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Imitate <a href="/w/Hostile_mob" class="mw-redirect" title="Hostile mob">hostile mobs</a> less often.</li>
<li>Do not randomly imitate hostile mobs when the game mode is set to <a href="/w/Peaceful" class="mw-redirect" title="Peaceful">Peaceful</a> difficulty.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Shulker" title="Shulker">Shulkers</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Shulkers with <code>NoAI</code> can now be summoned with rotation.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Skeleton" title="Skeleton">Skeletons</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now spawn in <a href="/w/Soul_sand_valley" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand valley">soul sand valleys</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Skeleton_horse" class="mw-redirect" title="Skeleton horse">Skeleton horses</a> and <a href="/w/Zombie_horse" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombie horse">zombie horses</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be leashed with a <a href="/w/Lead" title="Lead">lead</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Snow_golem" class="mw-redirect" title="Snow golem">Snow golems</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Shearing a snow golem drops the pumpkin.</li>
<li>Now take damage from splash and lingering water bottles.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Villager" title="Villager">Villagers</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Farmer villagers now put excess <a href="/w/Seeds" class="mw-disambig" title="Seeds">seeds</a> in their <a href="/w/Composter" title="Composter">composter</a>.
<ul><li>Use the <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">bone meal</a> received from the composter to grow crops.</li></ul></li>
<li>Farmers can now share excess <a href="/w/Wheat" title="Wheat">wheat</a> to other farmers, allowing them to make <a href="/w/Bread" title="Bread">bread</a>.</li>
<li>Villager workstation logic changes.
<ul><li>Villagers no longer try to work at the same workstation.</li>
<li>When a workstation is placed, the most experienced nearby villager for that corresponding profession gets the workstation.</li>
<li>Villagers now have to walk to and reach the workstation before they can acquire the profession/work there.</li>
<li>Villagers check and make sure their workstation is valid at all times of day as long as they are within 16 blocks of their workstation.</li>
<li>Villagers can no longer claim workstations/professions during raids or night time.</li></ul></li>
<li>The experience bar now accurately reflects how much experience villagers have and need.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Clock" title="Clock">Clocks</a> and <a href="/w/Compass" title="Compass">compasses</a> no longer function in the villager trading UI.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Witch" title="Witch">Witches</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>When a villager is struck by <a href="/w/Lightning" class="mw-redirect" title="Lightning">lightning</a>, the witch it converts to no longer despawns.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Wither" title="Wither">Withers</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can be summoned using <a href="/w/Soul_soil" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul soil">soul soil</a> as the base.</li>
<li>Can now be built sideways even at Y=0 and Y=1.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Wither_skeleton" class="mw-redirect" title="Wither skeleton">Wither skeletons</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now attack <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a> on sight.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Zombie_pigmen" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombie pigmen">Zombie pigmen</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Renamed to "Zombified Piglins", and given a new <a href="/w/Model" title="Model">model</a> and <a href="/w/Texture" class="mw-redirect" title="Texture">texture</a>.</li>
<li>Now spawn in <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forests</a>.</li>
<li>No longer attack <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">players</a> who have not attacked a zombified piglin.</li>
<li>Now stop being angry if the targeted <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a> dies nearby.</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Non-mob_entities">Non-mob entities</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=13&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Non-mob entities" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=13" title="Edit section's source code: Non-mob entities"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b> <a href="/w/Armor_stand" class="mw-redirect" title="Armor stand">Armor stands</a> </b>
</p>
<ul><li>No longer delete replaceable blocks such as snow, grass, fire etc. when placed inside them.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Item_frame" class="mw-redirect" title="Item frame">Item frames</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Have two new <a href="/w/Chunk_format#Other" title="Chunk format">data tags</a>:
<ul><li><code>Invisible</code> – makes item frame invisible (<a href="/w/Item" title="Item">item</a> inside frame remains visible).</li>
<li><code>Fixed</code> – prevents item frame from <a href="/w/Breaking" title="Breaking">breaking</a> and the item inside from being removed (it does not prevent item rotation).</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Minecart" title="Minecart">Minecarts</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now check dismount position height against <a href="/w/Entity" title="Entity">entity</a> height.</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="World_generation_2">World generation</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=14&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: World generation" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=14" title="Edit section's source code: World generation"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b>Ceiling</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Alongside mushrooms, huge crimson and warped fungi can generate over Y=128 in <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b>Floating Islands</b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Guardian" title="Guardian">Guardians</a> and <a href="/w/Pillager" title="Pillager">pillagers</a> now spawn correctly in floating islands worlds.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Nether_Wastes" title="Nether Wastes">Nether biome</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>The old "Nether" biome is now called "Nether Wastes".</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Structure" title="Structure">Structures</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Shipwreck" title="Shipwreck">Shipwrecks</a> and <a href="/w/Ocean_ruins" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Ocean ruins">ocean ruins</a> are now less common.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Fossil" title="Fossil">Fossils</a> no longer overlap desert temples.</li>
<li>Intersecting dungeons no longer replace spawners with cobblestone.</li>
<li>Fossils, ocean ruins, and <a href="/w/Monster_room" class="mw-redirect" title="Monster room">monster rooms</a> no longer overlap end portals.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Village" title="Village">Villages</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>"Jellie" <a href="/w/Cat" title="Cat">cats</a> now spawn naturally in <a href="/w/Village" title="Village">villages</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b>World types</b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Buffet" class="mw-redirect" title="Buffet">Buffet</a> worlds can no longer be created from <span style="font-family: monospace"><a href="/w/Server.properties" title="Server.properties">server.properties</a></span>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Zombie_village" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombie village">Zombie villages</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Zombie villagers that spawn in zombie villages no longer despawn.</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Command_format_2">Command format</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=15&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Command format" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=15" title="Edit section's source code: Command format"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b>General</b>
</p>
<ul><li>The message shown when running an unknown/incomplete command has changed.</li></ul>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/clear" title="Commands/clear">clear</a></span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/clear" title="Commands/clear">clear</a></span></code> now works with items in the inventory crafting grid.</li></ul>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/datapack" title="Commands/datapack">datapack</a></span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed the chat output when enabling/disabling a data pack from "Enabled/Disabled data pack <datapack>" to "Enabling/Disabling data pack <datapack>".<sup id="cite_ref-14" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-14"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>14<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/locate" title="Commands/locate">locate</a></span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Can now be used to locate <a href="/w/Nether_fossil" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether fossil">Nether fossils</a> and <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">bastion remnants</a>.</li>
<li>Structure names are now specified as lowercase.</li></ul>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/spawnpoint" title="Commands/spawnpoint">spawnpoint</a></span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Now supports being run in any of the dimensions.</li></ul>
<p><b><code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/spreadplayers" title="Commands/spreadplayers">spreadplayers</a></span></code></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added the ability to control the height.
<ul><li>Syntax: <code><span>/<a href="/w/Commands/spreadplayers" title="Commands/spreadplayers">spreadplayers</a> <center> <spreadDistance> <maxRange> under <maxHeight> <respectTeams> <targets></span></code>
<ul><li><code>maxHeight</code> specifies the maximum height for resulting positions.</li></ul></li></ul></li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Gameplay_2">Gameplay</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=16&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Gameplay" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=16" title="Edit section's source code: Gameplay"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b><a href="/w/Advancement" title="Advancement">Advancements</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>The "Serious Dedication" advancement has been changed.
<ul><li>It is now awarded for obtaining a <a href="/w/Netherite_hoe" class="mw-redirect" title="Netherite hoe">netherite hoe</a>.
<ul><li>Changed the description from "Completely use up a diamond hoe, and then reevaluate your life choices" to "Use a Netherite ingot to upgrade a hoe, and then reevaluate your life choices."</li>
<li>Has been renamed to <code>obtain_netherite_hoe.json</code>. This means progress in this advancement is not kept when upgrading to this version.</li></ul></li></ul></li>
<li>Changed the description of "Sweet Dreams" from "Change your respawn point" to "Sleep in a bed to change your respawn point."</li>
<li>Changed the description of "Not Today, Thank You" from "Deflect an arrow or trident with a shield" to "Deflect a projectile with a shield."</li>
<li>Changed the description of "Ice Bucket Challenge" from "Form and mine a block of obsidian" to "Obtain a block of obsidian."</li>
<li>Changed the description of "Sky's the Limit" from "Find Elytra" to "Find elytra."</li>
<li><a href="/w/Elder_guardian" class="mw-redirect" title="Elder guardian">Elder guardians</a>, <a href="/w/Ender_dragon" class="mw-redirect" title="Ender dragon">ender dragons</a>, <a href="/w/Endermite" title="Endermite">endermites</a>, <a href="/w/Hoglin" title="Hoglin">hoglins</a>, <a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">piglins</a>, <a href="/w/Vex" title="Vex">vexes</a>, <a href="/w/Wither" title="Wither">withers</a>, and <a href="/w/Zoglin" title="Zoglin">zoglins</a> can now be killed for the "<a href="/w/Advancement#Monster_Hunter" title="Advancement">Monster Hunter</a>" advancement, and they are now required for the "<a href="/w/Monsters_Hunted" class="mw-redirect" title="Monsters Hunted">Monsters Hunted</a>" advancement.</li>
<li>Breeding hoglins and striders can unlock now "<a href="/w/The_Parrots_and_the_Bats" class="mw-redirect" title="The Parrots and the Bats">The Parrots and the Bats</a>" advancement, and are required for the "<a href="/w/Two_by_Two" class="mw-redirect" title="Two by Two">Two by Two</a>" advancement.</li>
<li>The advancement "Two By Two" now requires <a href="/w/Donkey" title="Donkey">donkeys</a> and <a href="/w/Mule" title="Mule">mules</a> as well.
<ul><li>This advancement now checks the child resulting from breeding.</li></ul></li>
<li>Obtaining blackstone now also counts for the "Stone Age" advancement.</li>
<li>Removed the <code>safely_harvest_honey</code> advancement trigger as it was made redundant by <code>item_used_on_block</code>.</li>
<li>Added <code>player</code> check to every trigger (except <code>impossible</code>).
<ul><li>Due to addition of <code>player</code>, existing contents of <code>location</code>, <code>slept_in_bed</code>, <code>hero_of_the_village</code>, <code>voluntary_exile</code> can now be placed in <code>location</code> field instead of top-level object.
<ul><li>Old syntax is still supported, but deprecated.</li></ul></li></ul></li>
<li>Entity checks in triggers can now use loot table condition syntax.
<ul><li>All conditions in top level array must be met for whole condition to trigger</li>
<li>To access new functionality, top level element must be JSON array
<ul><li>JSON objects are interpreted as old notation</li></ul></li></ul></li>
<li>Full list of extended triggers:
<ul><li>New field <code>player</code> in every trigger</li>
<li><code>bred_animals</code>: <code>parent</code>, <code>partner</code>, <code>child</code></li>
<li><code>channeled_lightning</code>: <code>victims</code></li>
<li><code>cured_zombie_villager</code>: <code>zombie</code>, <code>villager</code></li>
<li><code>fishing_rod_hooked</code>: <code>entity</code></li>
<li><code>killed_by_crossbow</code>: <code>victims</code></li>
<li><code>player_killed_entity</code>: <code>entity</code></li>
<li><code>entity_killed_player</code>: <code>entity</code></li>
<li><code>player_hurt_entity</code>: <code>entity</code></li>
<li><code>summoned_entity</code>: <code>entity</code></li>
<li><code>tame_animal</code>: <code>entity</code></li>
<li><code>target_hit</code>: <code>projectile</code></li>
<li><code>villager_trade</code>: <code>villager</code></li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Ambience" title="Ambience">Ambience</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>New mood detection algorithm for cave sounds.
<ul><li>Aims to make ambient cave sounds play at more appropriate moments.
<ul><li>Mood increases the longer a player remains underground.</li>
<li>Mood increases the longer a player remains without or in the low sky <a href="/w/Light" title="Light">light</a> or block light.​<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><a href="/w/Special:TalkPage/Java_Edition_1.16" title="Special:TalkPage/Java Edition 1.16"><span title="What exactly are the parameters for increasing the mood? How deep underground? How dark? How and at which rate does the mood increase faster depending on how deep underground the player is or how low the light level is?" style="border-bottom: 1px dotted">more information needed</span></a></i>]</sup></li>
<li>Mood decreases and eventually resets the longer a player is neither underground nor in the absence of light.</li></ul></li>
<li>The player can check the percentage of the mood in the sounds info section in the <a href="/w/Debug_screen" title="Debug screen">debug screen</a>.
<ul><li>When the mood percentage reaches 100%, an ambient cave sound plays.</li></ul></li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Death_messages" title="Death messages">Death messages</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a new death message for being killed by an entity's wither skull projectile, "<player> was shot by a <entity>'s skull".</li></ul>
<p><b>Debug messages</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed the description of the F3+N shortcut in the F3+Q output from "F3 + N = Cycle creative <-> spectator" to "F3 + N = Cycle previous gamemode <-> spectator".</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Debug_screen" title="Debug screen">Debug screen</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a new line detailing mob spawning.
<ul><li><code>SC</code> represents the number of chunks in which mobs can spawn. It is the same value given in debug reports as <code>spawning_chunks</code>.</li>
<li><code>M</code>, <code>C</code>, <code>A</code>, <code>W</code>, and <code>M</code> represent the number of mobs for each group that contribute to that group's <a href="/w/Mob_cap" class="mw-redirect" title="Mob cap">mob cap</a>. The groups are <code>Monster</code>, <code>Creature</code>, <code>Ambient</code>, <code>Water_Creature</code>, and <code>Misc</code>. They're also in debug reports.</li></ul></li>
<li>In the Targeted Block and Targeted Fluid fields, the coordinates of the targeted block or fluid are now shown as well.
<ul><li>The "Looking At" field has been removed in favor of this.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Dual_wield" title="Dual wield">Dual wield</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Item can be swapped into the off-hand from any open inventory, instead from only the hotbar.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Enchantment" title="Enchantment">Enchantments</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>If the player has the <a href="/w/Mending" title="Mending">Mending</a> enchantment on any items, XP now always goes to healing the items before going to the XP bar.
<ul><li>Before, the enchantment would randomly choose an item when XP was received. If the item was fully healed, the XP would go to the XP bar.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Fishing" title="Fishing">Fishing</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>When fishing, treasure loot can now be obtained only by fishing in open waters.
<ul><li>A fishing location is considered to be open water if each layer in the 5×4×5 area around the bobber meets one and only one of the following criteria:
<ul><li>Have only water source blocks, waterlogged blocks without collision, or <a href="/w/Bubble_column" class="mw-redirect" title="Bubble column">bubble columns</a>.</li>
<li>Has only <a href="/w/Lily_pad" class="mw-redirect" title="Lily pad">lily pads</a>.</li></ul></li></ul></li>
<li>Lily pads are now considered junk fishing loot rather than treasure.</li></ul>
<p><b>Knockback resistance</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Is now a scale of the amount of knockback taken instead of a probability to take no knockback.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Patrol" title="Patrol">Patrols</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Patrols no longer spawn when the <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a> is close to any intact <a href="/w/Village" title="Village">village</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Recipe_book" title="Recipe book">Recipe book</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>The <a href="/w/Cartography_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Cartography table">cartography table</a> recipe now unlocks with <a href="/w/Paper" title="Paper">paper</a> instead of <a href="/w/String" title="String">string</a>.</li>
<li>Stained glass pane recipes now unlock only when the player has the same color of stained glass in their inventory.</li>
<li>Charcoal now unlocks using the <code>logs_that_burn</code> item tag.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Clock" title="Clock">Clocks</a> and <a href="/w/Compass" title="Compass">compasses</a> no longer function in the recipe book menu.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Repairing" class="mw-redirect" title="Repairing">Repairing</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Blackstone can now be used to repair stone tools.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Sound" title="Sound">Sounds</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Updated <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">block</a> sounds for <a href="/w/Bone_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone block">bone blocks</a>, <a href="/w/Netherrack" title="Netherrack">netherrack</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_bricks" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether bricks">Nether bricks</a> (and variants), <a href="/w/Nether_quartz_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether quartz ore">Nether quartz ore</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_wart_block" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wart block">Nether wart blocks</a>, and <a href="/w/Soul_sand" class="mw-redirect" title="Soul sand">soul sand</a>.</li>
<li><code>block.portal.travel</code> and <code>block.portal.trigger</code> sounds are now part of the "ambient/environment" sound category adjustable in <a href="/w/Option" class="mw-redirect" title="Option">options</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Shearing" class="mw-redirect" title="Shearing">Shearing</a> sound category was changed from "friendly creatures" to "<a href="/w/Player" title="Player">players</a>" for players using <a href="/w/Shears" title="Shears">shears</a> and to "<a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a>" for <a href="/w/Dispenser" title="Dispenser">dispensers</a> using shears.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/World_Spawn" class="mw-redirect" title="World Spawn">Spawn</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Player" title="Player">Players</a> can reset their spawn point using a <a href="/w/Bed" title="Bed">bed</a> when hostile <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mobs</a> are near, although players still cannot sleep when hostile mobs are near.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Subtitles" class="mw-redirect" title="Subtitles">Subtitles</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed the subtitle for <a href="/w/Zombified_piglin" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombified piglin">zombified piglins</a> angry grunts from "Zombified Piglin angers" to "Zombified Piglin grunts angrily".</li>
<li>Changed the subtitle for <a href="/w/Zombie_villager" class="mw-redirect" title="Zombie villager">zombie villagers</a> converting from "Zombie vociferates" to "Zombie Villager vociferates".</li>
<li>Changed the subtitle for zombie villagers being cured from "Zombie snuffles" to "Zombie Villager snuffles".</li>
<li>Changed the subtitle for stripping <a href="/w/Log" title="Log">logs</a> and <a href="/w/Wood" title="Wood">wood</a> from "Debarking log" to "Axe scrapes".</li>
<li>Changed the capitalization of "Blast furnace crackles" to "Blast Furnace crackles".</li>
<li>Changed the capitalization of "Enchanting table used" to "Enchanting Table used".</li>
<li>Changed the capitalization of "Turtle egg breaks" to "Turtle Egg breaks".</li>
<li>Changed the capitalization of "Turtle egg cracks" to "Turtle Egg cracks".</li>
<li>Changed the capitalization of "Turtle egg hatches" to "Turtle Egg hatches".</li>
<li>Removed the subtitle "Horse lands".</li></ul>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="General_2">General</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=17&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: General" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=17" title="Edit section's source code: General"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p><b><a href="/w/Animation" title="Animation">Animations</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Hand animations have been added for the following:
<ul><li>Entering a <a href="/w/Boat" title="Boat">boat</a><sup id="cite_ref-15" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-15"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>15<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Shearing <a href="/w/Sheep" title="Sheep">sheep</a> (a regression from 1.15.2).<sup id="cite_ref-16" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-16"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>16<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Feeding a brown <a href="/w/Mooshroom" title="Mooshroom">mooshroom</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-17" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-17"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>17<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Using a spawn egg on a mob to spawn a baby variant, if there wouldn't also be a block within reach through said mob.<sup id="cite_ref-18" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-18"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>18<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li></ul></li>
<li>Hand animations for the following have been removed:
<ul><li>Targeting a block through a mob then using a <a href="/w/Spawn_egg" class="mw-redirect" title="Spawn egg">spawn egg</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-19" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-19"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>19<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Attempting to switch a <a href="/w/Minecart_with_furnace" class="mw-redirect" title="Minecart with furnace">minecart with furnace</a>'s direction when it isn't on a rail<sup id="cite_ref-20" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-20"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>20<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Using a <a href="/w/Dye" title="Dye">dye</a> on a <a href="/w/Sheep" title="Sheep">sheep</a> which already has that color.<sup id="cite_ref-21" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-21"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>21<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Using a dye on a sheared sheep.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Attributes" class="mw-redirect" title="Attributes">Attributes</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Items and entities no longer keep unknown attributes.</li>
<li>Attribute names now use <a href="/w/Resource_location" class="mw-redirect" title="Resource location">resource locations</a>.</li>
<li>Names of some attributes have been renamed to meet resource location requirements (i.e., lowercase separated by underscores instead of camelCase).
<ul><li>Changed <code>generic.maxHealth</code> to <code>generic.max_health</code>.</li>
<li>Changed <code>zombie.spawnReinforcements</code> to <code>zombie.spawn_reinforcements</code>.</li>
<li>Changed <code>horse.jumpStrength</code> to <code>horse.jump_strength</code>.</li>
<li>Changed <code>generic.followRange</code> to <code>generic.follow_range</code>.</li>
<li>Changed <code>generic.knockbackResistance</code> to <code>generic.knockback_resistance</code>.</li>
<li>Changed <code>generic.movementSpeed</code> to <code>generic.movement_speed</code>.</li>
<li>Changed <code>generic.flyingSpeed</code> to <code>generic.flying_speed</code>.</li>
<li>Changed <code>generic.attackDamage</code> to <code>generic.attack_damage</code></li>
<li>Changed <code>generic.attackKnockback</code> to <code>generic.attack_knockback</code></li>
<li>Changed <code>generic.attackSpeed</code> to <code>generic.attack_speed</code></li>
<li>Changed <code>generic.armorToughness</code> to <code>generic.armor_toughness</code>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Block storage format</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Block storage format in chunks has been slightly changed to speed up various tasks (rendering, pathfinding, world generation, etc.).
<ul><li><code>BlockStates</code> in <code>Sections</code> elements no longer contain values stretching over multiple 64-bit fields.
<ul><li>If the number of bits per block is not a power of two (i.e. single 64-bit value can't fill whole number of blockstates) some bits are not used.</li>
<li>For example, if a single block state takes 5 bits, the highest 4 bits of every 64-bit field are unused. That also means a slight increase in storage size (in case of 5 bits, from 320 to 342 64-bit fields).</li></ul></li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Chat</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed the capitalization of "Click to copy to Clipboard" to "Click to Copy to Clipboard".</li>
<li>Changed "Your home bed was missing or obstructed" to "You have no home bed or charged respawn anchor, or it was obstructed".</li></ul>
<p><b><span style="font-family: monospace"><a href="/w/Client.jar" title="Client.jar">client.jar</a></span></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Removed <a href="/w/Realms" title="Realms">Realms</a> code from the client, but its assets remain.</li></ul>
<p><b>Collision</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Minor optimizations in collision detection.</li></ul>
<p><b>Credits</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Updated the credits.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Data_pack" title="Data pack">Data packs</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Slightly changed data pack loading to prevent custom data packs from crashing.</li>
<li>If data pack reload fails, changes are not applied and the game continues using previous data.</li>
<li>Changes to data pack list are stored only after successful reload.</li>
<li>If existing data packs prevent world from loading, the game gives option to load world in safe mode, which loads only vanilla data pack.</li>
<li>Added <code>--safeMode</code> option for servers to load only with vanilla data pack.</li>
<li>Game detects any critical data pack issues, such as required tags being missing, and prevents the world from being loaded.</li>
