<li>Entering the world in an unknown dimension (caused by disabling a <a href="/w/Data_pack" title="Data pack">data pack</a> which added said <a href="/w/Dimension" title="Dimension">dimension</a>) now puts the player in the <a href="/w/Overworld" title="Overworld">Overworld</a> at the same coordinates.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Debug_menu" class="mw-redirect" title="Debug menu">Debug menu</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>When outside the world's vertical area, the debug menu no longer lists 'minecraft:the_void' as the biome.
<ul><li>Instead, it simply hides the biome information.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Floating-point_arithmetic" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:Floating-point arithmetic">Floating-point</a> precision</b>
</p>
<figure class="mw-default-size mw-halign-right" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Bone_meal_precision_loss.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Bone_meal_precision_loss.png/300px-Bone_meal_precision_loss.png?cabbc" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="300" height="169" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Bone_meal_precision_loss.png/600px-Bone_meal_precision_loss.png?cabbc 2x" data-file-width="854" data-file-height="480"></a><figcaption>Bone meal particles being generated at the corner of the block instead of at the sapling, one of many precision loss bugs fixed by 1.16.</figcaption></figure>
<ul><li>Certain game mechanics, mainly a handful of different particles, have been modified to use 64-bit (<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Double-precision_floating-point_format" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:Double-precision floating-point format">double-precision</a>) precision where they previously used 32-bit (<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Single-precision_floating-point_format" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:Single-precision floating-point format">single-precision</a>).</li>
<li>As a result, the effects appear in the correct places even if the player is far away from the spawn point (with effects being the most extreme when over 16,777,216 blocks away). See <a href="/w/Java_Edition_distance_effects" title="Java Edition distance effects">Java Edition distance effects</a> for a further explanation and history of such effects.</li>
<li>The following precision loss errors are fixed:
<ul><li><a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">Bone meal</a> particles should now appear at the right position.<sup id="cite_ref-22" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-22"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>22<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li><a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">Lava</a> embers and popping sounds should now originate from the correct positions.<sup id="cite_ref-23" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-23"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>23<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li><a href="/w/Campfire" title="Campfire">Campfire</a> embers should now be generated at the correct position.<sup id="cite_ref-24" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-24"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>24<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Particles from <a href="/w/Redstone_repeater" class="mw-redirect" title="Redstone repeater">redstone repeaters</a> should now appear at the correct position.<sup id="cite_ref-25" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-25"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>25<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Particles from Nether biomes should now appear at the correct position.<sup id="cite_ref-26" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-26"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>26<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Particles from adding <a href="/w/Eye_of_ender" class="mw-redirect" title="Eye of ender">eye of enders</a> to <a href="/w/End_portal_frame" class="mw-redirect" title="End portal frame">end portal frames</a> should now appear at the correct position.<sup id="cite_ref-27" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-27"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>27<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Particles dripping from <a href="/w/Leaves" title="Leaves">leaves</a> during rain no longer snap to block corners and are correctly randomized across the underside of the block.<sup id="cite_ref-28" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-28"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>28<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>The book of the <a href="/w/Enchanting_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Enchanting table">enchanting table</a> now opens properly at high distances; previously there were cases where the player could be pressed right up to the block, yet the book would not acknowledge them.<sup id="cite_ref-29" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-29"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>29<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li><a href="/w/TNT" title="TNT">TNT</a> ignited by other explosions now appears at the right locations at high distances.<sup id="cite_ref-30" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-30"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>30<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li><a href="/w/Detector_rail" class="mw-redirect" title="Detector rail">Detector rails</a> at high distances were not always being correctly powered and depowered, which has been fixed.<sup id="cite_ref-31" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-31"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>31<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Mob spawning would also break down, spawning mobs at block corners and sometimes inside of other blocks.<sup id="cite_ref-32" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-32"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>32<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Generation of <a href="/w/Minecarts_with_chest" class="mw-redirect" title="Minecarts with chest">minecarts with chests</a> in <a href="/w/Mineshaft" title="Mineshaft">mineshafts</a> now spawns them at the intended positions.<sup id="cite_ref-33" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-33"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>33<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Fonts</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Chat component style now supports <code>font</code> property, which is resource location for font in the resource pack. No entry is equivalent to <code>minecraft:default</code>.</li>
<li>Full range of Unicode characters is supported, making it possible to type emojis and other Unicode characters outside of the <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plane_(Unicode)#Basic_Multilingual_Plane" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:Plane (Unicode)">Basic Multilingual Plane</a>.
<ul><li>However, custom resource packs must be used to display correct characters instead of tofu, due to the lack of these characters in the default font.</li></ul></li>
<li><code>Force Unicode</code> option now switches between normal and alternative font (called <code>uniform.json</code>) – no reload needed.</li>
<li>Many new characters have been added.
<ul><li>Includes several remaining Latin and Armenian-language ligatures<sup id="cite_ref-34" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-34"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>34<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> and the Georgian alphabet.</li>
<li>The new characters are: <span style="word-break:break-all;">´¨ᴀʙᴄᴅᴇꜰɢʜᴊᴋʟᴍɴᴏᴘꞯʀꜱᴛᴜᴠᴡʏᴢ§ɱɳɲʈɖɡʡɕʑɸʝʢɻʁɦʋɰɬɮʘǀǃǂǁɓɗᶑʄɠʛɧɫɨʉʊɘɵɤɜɞɑɒɚɝƁƉƑƩƲႠႡႢႣႤႥႦႧႨႩႪႫႬႭႮႯႰႱႲႳႴႵႶႷႸႹႺႻႼႽႾႿჀჁჂჃჄჅჇჍაბგდევზთიკლმნოპჟრსტუფქღყშჩცძწჭხჯჰჱჲჳჴჵჶჷჸჹჺ჻ჼჽჾჿתּשׂפֿפּכּײַיִוֹוּבֿבּꜧꜦɺⱱʠʗʖɭɷɿʅʆʓʚ₪₾֊ⴀⴁⴂⴃⴄⴅⴆⴡⴇⴈⴉⴊⴋⴌⴢⴍⴎⴏⴐⴑⴒⴣⴓⴔⴕⴖⴗⴘⴙⴚⴛⴜⴝⴞⴤⴟⴠⴥ⅛⅜⅝⅞⅓⅔✉☂☔☄⛄☃⌛⌚⚐✎❣♤♧♡♢⛈☰☱☳☴☶☷↔⇒⇏⇔⇵∀∃∄∉∋∌⊂⊃⊄⊅∧∨⊻⊼⊽∥≢⋆∑⊤⊥⊢⊨≔∁∴∵∛∜∂⋃⊆⊇□△▷▽◁◆◇○◎☆★✘₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉₊₋₌₍₎∫∮∝⌀⌂⌘〒ɼƄƅẟȽƚƛȠƞƟƧƨƪƸƹƻƼƽƾȡȴȵȶȺⱥȻȼɆɇȾⱦɁɂɃɄɈɉɊɋɌɍɎɏẜẝỼỽỾỿꞨꞩ𐌰𐌱𐌲𐌳𐌴𐌵𐌶𐌷𐌸𐌹𐌺𐌻𐌼𐌽𐌾𐌿𐍀𐍁𐍂𐍃𐍄𐍅𐍆𐍇𐍈𐍉𐍊🌧🔥🌊</span></li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Hitboxes</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Fire now has a hitbox, unlike previously, where it did not, when putting out fire required targeting its base blocks.</li>
<li>Redstone dust's hitbox now correctly confirms to its shape, much like the hitboxes of <a href="/w/Fence" title="Fence">fences</a>, <a href="/w/Wall" title="Wall">walls</a>, <a href="/w/Glass_pane" class="mw-redirect" title="Glass pane">glass panes</a>, and <a href="/w/Iron_bars" class="mw-redirect" title="Iron bars">iron bars</a>.
<ul><li>This also includes when the redstone is traveling up a vertical surface, so the upward portion can be targeted without hitting the block underlying.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Loot_table" title="Loot table">Loot tables</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Entity predicate
<ul><li>Added <code>fishing_hook</code> sub-predicate.</li></ul></li>
<li><code>fishing_hook</code>
<ul><li>Check properties of the fishing hook.</li>
<li><code>in_open_water</code> parameter matches whether the fishing location is open water fishing or not.</li>
<li>Can be set to "false" in-game files to make AFK fishing farms work again. This removes the restriction of being able to obtain loot only from normal waters.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Main_menu" class="mw-redirect" title="Main menu">Main menu</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>The main menu background is now set in the Nether.
<ul><li>The menu panorama uses seed <code>6006096527635909600</code> at coordinates X=482.208, Y=78.515, Z=-1127.193</li></ul></li>
<li>The "Singleplayer" button jumps directly to "Create World" screen if there are no worlds to select.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Materials" title="Materials">Materials</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added new Nether wood material.
<ul><li>Uses the wood material color.</li>
<li>Uses default properties.</li></ul></li>
<li>Whether or not a block requires a tool is now no longer a property of a material and is now assigned on a block-by-block basis.</li></ul>
<figure class="mw-default-size" typeof="mw:File/Thumb"><a href="/w/File:Splash2020.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Splash2020.png/300px-Splash2020.png?dc462" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="300" height="169" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Splash2020.png/600px-Splash2020.png?dc462 2x" data-file-width="854" data-file-height="480"></a><figcaption>New Mojang Studios logo on the loading screen.</figcaption></figure>
<p><b><a href="/w/Title_screen" class="mw-redirect" title="Title screen">Title screen</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Updated <a href="/w/Mojang_Studios" title="Mojang Studios">Mojang Studios</a> and <i><a href="/w/Minecraft" title="Minecraft">Minecraft</a></i> logos.</li></ul>
<p><b>Miscellaneous</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a JMX MBean to monitor dedicated server tick times.​<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><a href="/w/Special:TalkPage/Java_Edition_1.16" title="Special:TalkPage/Java Edition 1.16"><span title="What is it?" style="border-bottom: 1px dotted">more information needed</span></a></i>]</sup></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Model" title="Model">Models</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>All "block states" files have improved spacing, and now define the namespace when referring to the model.</li>
<li>All model files now define the namespace when referring to a different model.</li></ul>
<p><b>Multiplayer screen</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed "Online play is not rated" to "Caution: Third-Party Online Play".</li>
<li>Changed "During online play you may be exposed to chat messages or other types of user generated content that has not been rated, and may not be suitable for all ages." to "Caution: Online play is offered by third-party servers that are not owned, operated, or supervised by Mojang or Microsoft. During online play, you may be exposed to unmoderated chat messages or other types of user-generated content that may not be suitable for everyone."</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/NBT_tag" class="mw-redirect" title="NBT tag">NBT tags</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>The <code>Dimension</code> <a href="/w/NBT_tag" class="mw-redirect" title="NBT tag">NBT tag</a> is now a <a href="/w/Resource_location" class="mw-redirect" title="Resource location">resource location</a> string instead of a number, which is used in <a href="/w/Player.dat" class="mw-redirect" title="Player.dat">player.dat</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Obsidian_platform" class="mw-redirect" title="Obsidian platform">Obsidian platform</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Obsidian platform now can get regenerated when a non-player entity enters the End through an <a href="/w/End_portal" title="End portal">end portal</a>.</li></ul>
<p><b>Optimizing worlds</b>
</p>
<ul><li>The progress bar when optimizing worlds are now color-coded according to the type of <a href="/w/Dimension" title="Dimension">dimension</a>, and the ratio is calculated according to the number of chunks to optimize for each.
<ul><li>Green for the <a href="/w/Overworld" title="Overworld">Overworld</a>, brown for <a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">the Nether</a>, and light orange for <a href="/w/The_End" title="The End">the End</a>.</li>
<li>This applies even with custom dimensions.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Options</b>
</p>
<ul><li>The localization key for the offhand keybinding was changed from <code>key.swapHands</code> to <code>key.swapOffhand</code>.</li>
<li>Changed the description of the offhand swap key in the controls section from "Swap Item In Hands" to "Swap Item With Offhand".</li>
<li>Changed the description of fancy graphics to "'Fancy' graphics balances performance and quality for the majority of machines. [New line] Weather, clouds and particles may not appear behind translucent blocks or water."
<ul><li>Was previously "'Fancy' graphics balances performance and quality for the majority of machines."</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Particles" title="Particles">Particles</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li><span typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Glint_(texture)_JE1_BE1.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/thumb/Glint_%28texture%29_JE1_BE1.png/32px-Glint_%28texture%29_JE1_BE1.png?00d0a" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="32" height="32" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/Glint_%28texture%29_JE1_BE1.png/64px-Glint_%28texture%29_JE1_BE1.png?00d0a 2x" data-file-width="80" data-file-height="80"></a></span> <a href="/w/Bone_meal" class="mw-redirect" title="Bone meal">Bone meal</a> particles
<ul><li>Now use 64-bit floats for spawning, not 32-bit.
<ul><li>This means that using bone meal at high distances from the world origin (notably greater than 17 million) causes the particles to appear in expected places, and not far away from the target.</li></ul></li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Pathfinding</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Cached repeated block type lookups and collisions during pathfinding for increased performance.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Predicate" title="Predicate">Predicates</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Top-level element in predicate file can now be array (all contents are <code>AND</code>ed).</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Raw_JSON_text_format" class="mw-redirect" title="Raw JSON text format">Raw JSON text format</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>The JSON <code>color</code> component now supports 6-digit hexadecimal colors to specify custom colors other than the 16 default <a href="/w/Color_codes" class="mw-redirect" title="Color codes">color codes</a>.
<ul><li>Example: <code>/tellraw @a {"text":"Turquoise output","color":"#00ff88"}</code></li></ul></li>
<li>The <code>hoverEvent</code> chat component now uses the parameter <code>contents</code>, with contents depending on type:
<ul><li>For <code>show_text</code> – chat component</li>
<li>For <code>show_item</code> – either item id or object with fields <code>id</code>, <code>count</code> and <code>tag</code> (with last one being serialized NBT)</li>
<li>For <code>show_entity</code> – object with fields: <code>id</code> (UUID), <code>name</code> (chat component) and <code>type</code> (entity type resource location)</li>
<li>The <code>value</code> argument is now deprecated, but still supported.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Realms" title="Realms">Realms</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Removed translation strings of:
<ul><li><code>mco.create.world.seed</code>.</li>
<li><code>mco.trial.title</code>.</li>
<li><code>mco.trial.unavailable</code>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Recipe_book" title="Recipe book">Recipe book</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>There is now a text that says "Search..." in the recipe book.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Region_file_format" title="Region file format">Region files</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Region files are now opened in synchronous mode only on Windows, not on other operating systems. Status of this feature can be manually controlled by following options:
<ul><li>For dedicated servers: <code>sync-chunk-writes</code> within <code>server.properties</code>.</li>
<li>For clients: <code>syncChunkWrites</code> within <code>options.txt</code>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>Rendering</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Improved entity shadows to the ground.</li>
<li>Made experimental changes to graphics rendering.</li>
<li>Added shader support for accessing the depth buffer.</li>
<li>The renderer now uses per-pixel blending layers for some transparent elements.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Saved_hotbar" class="mw-redirect" title="Saved hotbar">Saved toolbars</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Renamed to "Saved Hotbars"</li></ul>
<p><b>Servers</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added a <code>enable-status</code> option to the <a href="/w/Server.properties" title="Server.properties">server.properties</a> file which if set to <code>false</code> suppresses replies to status requests from clients.
<ul><li>This makes the server appear offline in the multiplayer screen.</li></ul></li>
<li>Added control over how much entity data a server sends to clients: <code>entity-broadcast-range-percentage</code> server property, controlling how close entities need to be before being sent to clients.
<ul><li>Higher values mean entities are visible further away from players but cause more network traffic.</li>
<li>Specifies a percentage of the default value so, for example, <code>50</code> specifies half of the default range.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Splash" title="Splash">Splashes</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>The splash "Sexy!" was changed to "Moderately attractive!"</li>
<li>Removed some splashes:
<ul><li>Undocumented!</li>
<li>Down with O.P.P.!</li>
<li>Lewd with two dudes with food!</li>
<li>Switches and ores!</li>
<li>Huge tracts of land!</li>
<li>Totally forgot about Dre!</li>
<li>Popping tags!</li>
<li>Getting ready to show!</li>
<li>Getting ready to know!</li>
<li>Getting ready to drop!</li>
<li>Getting ready to shock!</li>
<li>Getting ready to freak!</li>
<li>Getting ready to speak!</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Statistics" title="Statistics">Statistics</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>General statistics are now ordered alphabetically in the statistics menu.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Superflat" title="Superflat">Superflat</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Removed structure settings from flat level preset strings as it was broken due to the addition of customizable worlds.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/Tag" class="mw-disambig" title="Tag">Tags</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Added crimson and warped wooden <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">items</a> to the <code>planks</code>, <code>standing_signs</code>, <code>wall_signs</code>, <code>wooden_buttons</code>, <code>wooden_doors</code>, <code>wooden_fences</code>, <code>wooden_pressure_plates</code>, <code>wooden_slabs</code>, <code>wooden_stairs</code>, and <code>wooden_trapdoors</code> block tags.</li>
<li>Added crimson and warped wooden items to the <code>planks</code>, <code>signs</code>, <code>wooden_buttons</code>, <code>wooden_doors</code>, <code>wooden_fences</code>, <code>wooden_pressure_plates</code>, <code>wooden_slabs</code>, <code>wooden_stairs</code>, and <code>wooden_trapdoors</code> item tags.</li>
<li>Added polished blackstone, and (where applicable) blackstone blocks and items to the <code>buttons</code>, <code>slabs</code>, <code>stairs</code>, and <code>walls</code> block and item tags.</li>
<li>Added potted <a href="/w/Crimson_fungus" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson fungus">crimson fungus</a>, <a href="/w/Crimson_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson roots">crimson roots</a>, <a href="/w/Warped_fungus" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped fungus">warped fungus</a>, and <a href="/w/Warped_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped roots">warped roots</a> to the <code>flower_pots</code> <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">block</a> tag.</li>
<li>Added <a href="/w/Crying_obsidian" class="mw-redirect" title="Crying obsidian">crying obsidian</a> and <a href="/w/Respawn_anchor" class="mw-redirect" title="Respawn anchor">respawn anchors</a> to the <code>dragon_immune</code> block tag.</li>
<li>Updated block tag <code>enderman_holdable</code>.
<ul><li>Added <a href="/w/Nether_fungi" class="mw-redirect mw-disambig" title="Nether fungi">Nether fungi</a>, <a href="/w/Nylium" title="Nylium">nylium</a> variants, <a href="/w/Crimson_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson roots">crimson roots</a>, and <a href="/w/Warped_roots" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped roots">warped roots</a>.</li>
<li>Removed <a href="/w/Netherrack" title="Netherrack">netherrack</a> variant.</li></ul></li>
<li>The <code>slabs</code> block and item tags now use the respective <code>wooden_slabs</code> tag.</li>
<li>Changed the <code>logs</code> block and item tags to use the <code>logs_that_burn</code>, <code>crimson_stems</code>, and <code>warped_stems</code> block and item tags, respectively.</li>
<li>Changed the <code>music_discs</code> item tag to use the <code>creeper_drop_music_discs</code> item tag and the <a href="/w/Pigstep" class="mw-redirect" title="Pigstep">Pigstep</a> music disc.</li>
<li>Changed the <code>stairs</code> block and item tags to use their respective <code>wooden_stairs</code> tag.
<ul><li>This has effectively made <a href="/w/Crimson_stairs" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson stairs">crimson stairs</a> and <a href="/w/Warped_stairs" class="mw-redirect" title="Warped stairs">warped stairs</a> a part of this tag.</li></ul></li>
<li>The <code>sand</code> block tag is now used to determine whether turtle eggs can hatch on a block.</li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/The_Nether" title="The Nether">The Nether</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed the ambient lighting in the Nether; it is now much darker.</li></ul>
<p><b>UUIDs</b>
</p>
<ul><li>UUIDs stored in NBT are also represented as an array of four integers, rather than <code>UUIDMost</code>/<code>UUIDLeast</code>.
<ul><li>Example: <code>{UUID:[I;1498693494,1027158888,1898994005,860320107]}</code></li>
<li>Renamed a couple of fields:
<ul><li><code>OwnerUUID</code> of tamed animals, area effect clouds, evoker fangs and projectiles is now simply <code>Owner</code>.</li>
<li><code>TrustedUUIDs</code> of foxes is now <code>Trusted</code>.</li>
<li><code>target_uuid</code> of conduits is now <code>Target</code>.</li></ul></li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b><a href="/w/World" title="World">Worlds</a></b>
</p>
<ul><li>Old customized worlds (from before <a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.13" title="Java Edition 1.13">Java Edition 1.13</a>) now say "Old Customized" in the world selection screen.</li></ul>
<p><b>World creation</b>
</p>
<ul><li>A loading screen is now displayed while the game is reading world data for loading, creating or re-creating a world.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Commands/gamerule" title="Commands/gamerule">Gamerule</a> descriptions now span multiple lines if needed on the game rules screen.</li>
<li>Changed the capitalization of some strings.
<ul><li>"Create backup and load" was changed to "Create Backup and Load".</li>
<li>"Go back" was changed to "Go Back".</li>
<li>"Reset to default" was changed to "Reset to Default".</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>World save files</b>
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Anvil_file_format" title="Anvil file format">Region files</a> are now opened in synchronous mode to increase prevent data loss and corruption after a crash.
<ul><li>Dedicated servers can disable that by changing sync-chunk-writes inside <span style="font-family: monospace"><a href="/w/Server.properties" title="Server.properties">server.properties</a></span>.</li></ul></li></ul>
<p><b>World save format</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Saving <code>level.dat</code> now uses randomly-named temporary files (instead of using <code>level.dat_new</code> every time).</li>
<li><code>player/*.dat</code> are now saved in a way similar to <code>level.dat</code> (including leaving <code>.dat_old</code> files).</li></ul>
<p><b>World selection</b>
</p>
<ul><li>Changed "Failed to access level" to "Failed to access world".</li>
<li>Changed "Failed to delete level" to "Failed to delete world".</li></ul>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Trivia">Trivia</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?section=20&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Trivia" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.16?action=edit&section=20" title="Edit section's source code: Trivia"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<ul><li>This update surpassed <a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.14" title="Java Edition 1.14">1.14</a> for hosting the largest addition of new blocks into the Java Edition of the game, adding a total of 74 compared to 69. This record was surpassed by the <a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.17" title="Java Edition 1.17">following update</a>.</li>
<li>Starting with 1.16, all major update version numbers are the same for both the <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java</i></a> and <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock</i></a> editions.<sup id="cite_ref-Skipping_35-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Skipping-35"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>35<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-36" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-36"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>36<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>1.16 fixes the most bugs that were existent prior to its development out of any release version, beating <a href="/w/Java_Edition_1.8" title="Java Edition 1.8">1.8</a>.</li></ul>
